meta.name: Annecy International Animation Film Festival
notes: Festival: Annecy International Animation Film Festival (Festival international du film d'animation d'Annecy), organised by CITIA. Annual since 1998; editions 41st (2017) to 50th (2026); edition = year - 1976 (the official 2026 editorials call 2026 the '50e édition').

Official website: https://www.annecy.org, which now redirects to https://www.annecyfestival.com (same official site). All rows are tagged 'Official (annecyfestival.com)'. The legacy archive prints film links as www.annecy.org/about/archives/...; the recorded URLs are the annecyfestival.com addresses those links resolve to.

Primary source 2017-2024: the official legacy archive, English version: /about/archives/<year>/official-selection (section list), /about/archives/<year>/official-selection:<code> (films of each section) and the official film index page of each film (/about/archives/<year>/official-selection/film-index:film-<id>), which supplies original and English title, directors, countries of production, running time and synopsis.

Primary source 2025-2026 (and Annecy Presents 2024): the current official site's Official Selection pages (2025: /archives/2025/le-festival/selection-officielle-2025 and its sections; 2026: /le-festival/selection-officielle/... ) in their English version (hreflang alternate) and each film's official page (synopsis, running time, country of production, direction). The film card gives the English title and, below it, the original title.

French-only pages: 2024 Annecy Presents, 2025 Screening Events and 2025 Annecy Presents have no English version on the official site. For these rows the title is the original title shown on the card (or the French display title when the card shows no other title), the synopsis is the official French synopsis, and French country names were translated to English; the selection status says 'French-language official page only'.

Awards: the official award pages (2017-2024 /about/archives/<year>/award-winners; 2025 /en/le-festival/2025-awards; 2026 /en/the-festival/2026-awards) link every prize to the film's archive entry. Only the official prizes of the competition juries and the official audience awards are recorded (groups Feature films, Short films, TV and commissioned films, Graduation films, VR/Immersive works; e.g. Cristal, Jury Award, Contrechamp prizes, Paul Grimault, Jean-Luc Xiberras, Alexeïeff-Parker, Lotte Reiniger, Off-Limits, Gan Foundation Award for Distribution, Audience Awards). The separate 'Special Prizes' group (City of Annecy, André Martin, FIPRESCI, Festivals Connexion, Junior Jury, SACEM music awards, France TV, CANAL+ etc.: partner or independent juries) is not recorded. Every official prize matched a film in the database.

Scope (sections organised by the festival in its Official Selection): Feature Films Official competition; Contrechamp competition (from 2019); short film competition (L'officielle, Perspectives, Off-Limits from 2018, Young Audiences from 2018, Midnight Shorts and WTF in 2026); Graduation Films; TV Films; Commissioned Films; VR / Immersive Works; and the non-competitive Annecy Presents, Midnight Specials, Screening Events (Séances événements) and Annecy Classics where the official site lists their films. Excluded: Mifa (market) and its pitches/industry programmes, Work in Progress presentations (listed under the 2020-2023 Official Selection archive but presentations of films in production, not screenings of finished films; the current site files them under 'Rencontres'), open-air screenings, tributes/thematic programmes, exhibitions, masterclasses outside the Screening Events list.

Short films 2017-2022: the legacy archive leaves part of the short film competition without a sub-category (list 'cm' 'Official Short Films in Competition': 84 films in 2017, 1 in 2018, 13 in 2019, 17 in 2020, 5 in 2021, 1 in 2022 - in 2019 these are mainly the prize-winners). Because the sub-section lists are incomplete for those years, the whole short film competition is one program 'Short Films in Competition' for 2017-2022; the archive's sub-category is kept in the selection status when given. From 2023 the archive/current site classify every short, so L'officielle, Perspectives, Off-Limits and Young Audiences (and in 2026 Midnight Shorts, WTF) are separate programs.

The legacy archive attaches to some 2024 section lists films entered for earlier editions (archive ids of an earlier year, e.g. 'Fantastic Mr. Fox' 2010 in 2024 features, 22 Portuguese-animation tribute shorts in 2024 'L'officielle', 'Despicable Me 3' 2017 in 2024 Screening Events). The current site's 2024 section pages (French) confirm they are not part of the 2024 sections (e.g. L'officielle shorts 2024 = 31 on both after removal), so entries whose id belongs to an earlier edition are skipped, except in Annecy Classics and Midnight Specials, which show older films by design (Phi 1.618, id of the 2022 edition, kept in 2023 Midnight Specials). The skipped entries are listed in raw/official/fetch_log.txt.

2024: the legacy archive is used for every section it lists (English, structured); Annecy Presents 2024 comes from the current site (French page only). The current site's 2024 'Longs métrages L'officielle' page mixes the 5 Midnight Specials into the feature competition; the legacy archive's separate lists are used instead.

Not extracted (no complete official listing): Screening Events / out-of-competition screenings 2017-2020 (the archive lists Screening Events only from 2021); Midnight Specials before 2023; Annecy Classics 2017-2022, 2024 (the 2024 page lists no films) and 2025 (no Annecy Classics section on the 2025 selection page); Annecy Presents before 2024 (not in the legacy archive).

2020: the festival was held exclusively online ('Annecy Online', 15-30 June 2020) because of the Covid-19 pandemic; the official 2020 Official Selection (competitions) is recorded as that year's programs. 2021: hybrid edition (on site 14-19 June 2021 plus online), also the festival's 60th anniversary.
2026: the 50th edition took place in June 2026 (before the 2026-11-01 cut-off) and is included from the current site's Official Selection pages and the 2026 awards page.

Runtime is the official running time rounded to the nearest minute (e.g. '00 h 07 min 30 s' -> 8 minutes). For 2025-2026 Screening Events presentations (studio previews, masterclasses) the official 'running time' is the length of the session. Directors are taken from the official 'Directed by' / 'Direction' field (surnames printed in capitals in the source are softened by the toolkit); presentations without a credited director are Unknown.

Official Number of Films = number of entries extracted from the official list of that section and year. A film in two sections (e.g. a feature in competition and in another section) is a separate row per section.
Wikipedia has no usable yearly pages for the Annecy festival's sections, so no Wikipedia adapter is configured; there are no supplementary (non-official) rows.

Fields with no verified official source are exactly 'Unknown'. Premiere status is not given by the official archive and is not recorded. Director history (previous appearance/award) is derived from this 2017-2026 database only.

Premiere status (checked 2026-11-02): Annecy does not publish a per-film premiere label. Neither the cached official pages (legacy archive film-index pages 2017-2024, current Drupal film pages 2024-2026) nor live checks of current film pages in English and French (e.g. /en/the-festival/official-selection/feature-films/2026-feature-films-official/decorado and /waves, legacy /about/archives/2019/official-selection/film-index:film-20193095) carry any 'World/International/... Premiere' label (the only 'premiere' strings are synopsis prose and a partner logo). The official submission rules (helpdesk.annecyfestival.com, 'Mon film est-il éligible s'il a déjà été diffusé ...') require no exclusivity except that selected feature films be unreleased in France until the end of the Festival, with an explicit exception for films from Cannes (Official Selection, Directors' Fortnight, Critics' Week, ACID); this is not a rule that every film of a section is a given premiere, so no section rule applies. Premiere status is 'Unknown' for all films.

All the characters from the Théâtre du Passage's 2022-2023 season arrive at the same time in the theatre's forecourt.
Legendary rock 'n' roll magazine "CREEM" is coming back to print for the first time after 33 years. The rough, gritty, Detroit-based answer to "Rolling Stone Magazine"'s laid-back Californian vibes.
An old woman is carrying her shopping. A boy carrying a gun on his back is riding a scooter. Birds are flying. A city is collapsing. A party is in full swing.
Music video for Cécile McLorin Salvant. The lore of Melusine.
An associative and dazzling journey of discovery ensues as a woman immerses herself in traumatic childhood memories and learns to come to terms with her loneliness and feeling of emptiness.
Death of a beloved pet is a difficult thing to deal with and even though we try to prepare for it, it always seems to come too soon. This is the story of a boy and his dog Dede, who passes away.
A girl strays into the dreamy deep-sea world. In the deepest part of the sea, all secrets are hidden.
An interpretation about personality loss. The tree grows and buries its crown back in the earth, the world returns to primal matter, the consumer is consumed.
"We're not gonna make a short film about potatoes…" - "Just fry and stop me!", said the potato. So, we made a short film about potatoes.

On Hachijojima Island, Tokyo, an international team of engineers unite for a large-scale operation inside the "Pacific Buoy", an offshore facility that links police security cameras together around the world. Meanwhile, Conan, who is visiting the island with the Junior Detectives, finds out that a Europol employee has been murdered in Germany by the Men in Black Organisation. Alarmed, he sneaks into the Pacific Buoy and discovers a female engineer has been kidnapped by the Organisation. A sinister rumbling echoes through the ocean depths as a dark shadow looms over Ai Haibara...
Five friends growing up in Berlin Spandau experience surrealism of adolescence with all its magic, emotion and adventure.
Dodo's father is a big blue bird. One day he flies out of the window and doesn't come back. From that day onwards Dodo stops growing up.
Misfortune deported a ballet dancer Sergei to a suburban kolkhoz. Here, he's having his mundane battles against routine, domestic animals and alcohol.
A new and experimental perspective about a dog running after a ball in the park. My film is about feeling united with the universe, we are all one: humans, dogs, tennis ball, nature, particles.
What does family mean to you, your family and their family?

films.ot: El show del Dr. Gecko "Sex Gender"
films.syn: Dr. Gecko stars in this humorous animated talk-show about science and genomics. In this special episode, with help from friends, they take on "Sex and Gender" from a positive scientific perspective.
Two people adrift at sea are fighting a bloody battle for both their survival and their relationship.

films.t: Edmond and Lucy "Goodbye Piney Pine Tree"
films.syn: Meet Edmond and Lucy in their daily adventures in the forest: Nature is their best playmate! A series produced in real-time CGI to reach a lower carbon footprint and an enhanced graphic quality.
It's pouring down with rain at the funeral. There's a lot of crying, too much wine, several woodpeckers and a couple of dreams that fill in the gaps.
Electra thinks back to her 10th birthday, mixing memories with dreams and hidden fantasies. Is our memory just fiction? Or is it a myth?

Pixar's all-new, original feature film is set in Element City, where fire-, water-, land- and air-residents live together. The story introduces Ember, a tough, quick-witted and fiery young woman, whose friendship with a fun, sappy, go-with-the-flow guy named Wade challenges her beliefs about the world they live in.
A girl just wants to spend time with her mother, who is busy at work trying to save the Earth.
An inconvenient truth - the Western fashion industry is based on forced child labor in the Third World. Will you still consent to it?
Karun, a stray dog, fights to survive in a chaotic environment ravaged by drought.
A Migration presentation featuring never-before-seen footage as well as a conversation with Illumination's Chris Meledandri and Director Benjamin Renner.
After Poppy discovers that Branch was once part of her favorite boy band with his brothers, whom he hasn't seen since, they embark on an emotional journey to reunite them.

In the kingdom of Rosas, Asha, a sharp-witted idealist, makes a wish so powerful that it's answered by a cosmic force - a ball of boundless energy called Star. Asha and Star confront the formidable King Magnifico to prove that when the will of one courageous human connects with the magic of the stars, wondrous things can happen.
During Mexico's colonial period, an ailing Spanish priest will himself have to endure the very native rituals that he was persecuting.

Native American teenagers confront an oil pipeline project, which is just down the hill from their ancestral land. The grandfather evokes the ancient tale of their Creation, reminding all of us that we need to find our place in the great circle of creatures.
Based on this strange cultural phenomenon, this aims to show the hedonistic life of a palace's people, where foxes are used as playthings with a death sentence.
An immersion into art through two paintings on the same subject created half a century apart.
A compact illustration of social disruption. A civilization blossoms, with all its contradictions, only to become a danger to itself.
A crush gone moldy...

This film paints a non-exhaustive, offbeat portrait of a counter-cultural movement of anthropomorphic animal lovers, the Furries. This community, often associated with various sexual fetiches, has become a real social phenomenon.

Young Testuro Hoshino's life-long dream is to be transformed into a human-robot to become immortal. He leaves Megalopolis to board the 999, the space train. Unknowingly, he embarks on a fantastic quest through space and worlds he never imagined.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Annecy Classics) - film entry from an earlier edition (archive id 791035)

films.syn: The anemone flower that "I" liked. A precious flower that holds memories which tie "You" and "I" together. A story that represents "Me", "You", our "Childhood Friend" and our goodbyes.
In the Kerameikos museum, a sculpture on the tomb of a young boy Euphiros comes to life and tells us about his own dream to become a worthy citizen of Athens.
A woman gives shape to octopuses out of her own flesh. When she runs out of matter, she has to face what she has created.

films.t: Google "Heroes of Small Business: Casa Botín"
films.syn: Jeanette Nørgaard directs the story of "Casa Botín", the oldest restaurant in the world and the changes they've faced within 300 years of service.
The official music video for Gorillaz's "Silent Running ft. Adeleye Omotayo". See Murdoc, Noodle and Russel solve the mystery of 2D's disappearance in an epic face-off with a Hollywood-based cult.
In a world ruled by crows and discrimination, a young girl decides to fight for justice.
Told through the eyes of a child with an overflowing imagination, this is a poetic, luminous look at bereavement and coping with the loss of a parent.
A haptic and musical movie about a romantic encounter.
One day, my granny dyed her wedding dress black. She wanted to be buried in it.
This is a sensitive short film about child poverty. It tells the story of three children, of different origins, family and living conditions and their everyday struggles.
When the angry and ugly chihuahua Henk is finally adopted from the shelter, it turns out his new boss wants to use him as a social media vehicle to satisfy her desperate hunger for attention.
Loneliness. Strong winds and aurora. What do you feel when you listen to the ocean or when an aurora takes you towards the storm?
A visualisation of my senses' perceptions, the imagined worlds and memories of the past as the author.
A struggle between inner chaos and reality explodes to create a world of cowboys, horses and Western landscapes.

films.t: I Can't Go on Like This by Aria Covamonas from Planet Earth
films.syn: Some individuals tell their gloomy stories and then transform into something horrible.

films.t: I Took a Lethal Dose of Herbs
films.syn: A VR film about postpartum psychosis and DIY abortion told through the hallucinatory experience of a former anti-abortion activist. Based on a true story from an anonymous woman posting on Reddit.
A self-absorbed cat, in a jazzy song and dance, proudly and comically proclaims his "hipness" to the world. The world is less convinced than he is.

A cathartic and dynamic 6DOF trip into the mind of an artist in turmoil. In this immersive artwork with light interaction, viewers travel through different scenes and seasons that show both the soft and fiery sides of a fighter spirit.

Two sisters, the last of their kind who live in hiding on their ravaged land, squabble about how to survive with the Empire encroaching. On a water run, the sisters must fight back when they are discovered.

films.t: Inspector Sun and the Curse of the Black Widow
films.syn: Set in the world of bugs where spiders are the cops, a detective boards a seaplane to San Francisco after finally capturing his arch nemesis, but a murder on his flight draws him into a plot that threatens both the human and bug worlds.
Two abstract energies fall in love, unite as one and disappear into a vanishing point.
What was young gets old, what was healthy is sick. Uncertainty has crept in. What started out tough ends in melancholy. In that sense, this is a farewell.
This recounts the history of a small, secluded island over the course of several millennia, to reveal a telling lesson about human nature.

On a black background, pencil particles dance until they take the form of two human silhouettes. Next, more realistic settings take shape. The dancers move through them until they disappear, taking everything with them. Nothing remains.

films.t: Johnny & Me - A Journey through Time with John Heartfield
films.ot: Johnny & Me - Eine Zeitreise mit John Heartfield
films.syn: Graphic designer Stefanie is having a creative crisis with boring advertising assignments and a boss who does not value her work. During a visit to a museum, she is magically attracted to the satirical photomontages of the world-famous colleague and Nazi opponent John Heartfield. Then a miracle happens, she suddenly turns up in his studio.
The impact of drug trafficking on society has many facets: some of them are shown in this short film using animated charcoal drawings on wood.

films.t: Kaina of the Great Snow Sea: Star Sage
films.syn: A world blanketed in an endless and ever-growing ocean of snow. The people eke out a living, either huddled around the roots of enormous trees dotting the surface, or high up in the canopy which spreads over the planet's atmosphere.

Trico loves to share new objects and ideas with his fellow sheep. This causes a ruckus in the mountain pastures but also new trouble for Wanda, a tough ewe who has to keep the sheep safe from the wolf.

A young boy, shipwrecked on a remote island, discovers he's not alone when he encounters a hostile old Japanese soldier who retreated there after World War II. As dangerous invaders appear on the horizon, it becomes clear they must join forces to save their fragile island paradise.

Kotaro visits Komada Distillery for a project on Japanese craft whisky. Led by young female president Rui, who took over the family business, the distillery works hard to reproduce its signature whisky, Koma, which they had to stop making years ago. However, not to mention financial backing, too many clues are missing to revive the once lost whisky.
On Finistère's coast, a sailor bids farewell to his family and this time he will not return. Years later, his son, a sailor himself, must also sail away. A ghost emerges from the past.

"Oasis" is an inner source of inspiration. It evokes the singer's internal strength and plurality. This collection of techniques illustrates the richness emanating from a meeting between the two artists Marion Castéra and La Chica.

With nearly 70 monumental works of art scattered throughout the district, La Défense in Paris is Europe's largest open-air museum. Sitting between the legs of the gigantic Red Spider, I wonder how I hadn't noticed them before?
Based on the concert "La Notte" by A. Vivaldi. Carnival in Venice: Pulcinella attempts to slip into a VIP party, without too much success. His dream of the rich and famous will turn into a nightmare.
In Bogota, a bird-girl leaves behind the family home, her domineering mother and faithful dog to go and explore her sexuality.

1980. Abadan, Iran. The residents hold out against an Iraqi siege. Among them, 14-year-old Omid decides to stay in the city with his grandfather until his older brother returns. Omid finds an abandoned boat in Abadan's port. Could this be the way to save his family?
A pizza guy goes on a late-night delivery to a suburban apartment. Despite long flights of stairs, room 1601 is nowhere to be found. Instead, he is left with grim, mysterious illusions and traces.
In the blessed forest, taste the rich delights created by nature's harmonious resources. The message for children who will live in the future world.

films.t: Lloyd of the Flies "The Wasp Sting"
films.syn: Young fly Lloyd faces endless awkward, annoying and occasionally life-threatening situations - because when you're one centimetre high, even tiny problems can lead to massive consequences.

Kokoro, a young girl in her first year at high school, plays truant because she's being bullied by her classmates. One day in May, when she stays locked in her bedroom, she meets six high-schoolers in a similar situation to her own, in a castle in her bedroom mirror. Adventures with them lie ahead.
A Rohingya man is stranded in the Andaman Sea on a fishing boat loaded with men, women and children fleeing for their lives. He is haunted by the song his mother sang him. Why did he have to escape?
Laurence is desperately looking for love. Following a friend's advice, she connects to online dating sites to find her soulmate. She becomes addicted to her phone and addicted to a toxic man.
This is a set of pre-show animations commissioned by M+ Museum. Inspired by Shek Kip Mei Park, Shatin's cycling track and M+ Museum, this work captures Hong Kong's unique cityscape.
Based on a four-on-the-floor beat and a Wall of Sound. On top of that is a landscape full of motion and colour, which offers a new perspective.
Trapped in a neglectful family situation a protective older brother takes care of his younger sibling and confronts his absent mother, which leads to a rash decision.
A mesmerising contemplation of moving bodies and painting, with three magnificent contemporary dance performers from Montreal, Marie Mougeolle, Eduardo Ruiz Vergara and Sophie Corriveau.

Aline Ruby, a stubborn private detective and Carlos Rivera, an android replica of her partner who died five years before, set off on a race against time to Mars. Their mission is to find Jun Chow, a cybernetics student on the run, before the assassins hot on her heels kill her.

In 1942, on a train to nowhere, a former drag queen remembers a night from her past in one of Paris' first queer bars. Remnants of customer gossip recall this mythic bar and its mysterious Jewish-Algerian owner.

Stanford Yu works as a janitor at the Academy. Stanford and his classmates must put aside all personal differences and work together as a team in order to defend humanity against a new invasion of aliens.
The hamsters live and work in Hamsterland, which is a perfect state with a perfect economy. The GDP grows steadily, there is no unemployment and 100% of the population declare themselves to be happy.
A mysterious scientist crosses dimensions to rescue a spirit boy from the realm of the gods.
Motus: a body in motion. A stop-motion animation where conception, degradation and regeneration cohabit in a unique way. A creation on a metal sheet using ethanol as the raw material.

Every day, Mr. Passenger is drawn to travelling in a new direction that is crammed full of adventures. Throughout all the journeys he takes, humour and the absurd give rise to many questions and discoveries.
Videoclip for the band Municipal Waste. An improvised concert in a cemetery attracts a whole bunch of lovely people to the party.
Yang Jian, a once-powerful god now turned penniless bounty hunter, must confront his past to save the world.

Edo City is plunged into darkness, a man emerges from the attic of a house. It is the famous Jirokichi, nicknamed Nezumikozō/The Rat, a righteous criminal who steals from the rich to give to the poor. Orin leads a hard life with her young child. Taking advantage of this poor woman's distress some yakuzas try to expose the Nezumikozō/The Rat's true identity.

When a knight in a futuristic medieval world is framed for a crime he didn't commit, the only one who can help him prove his innocence is Nimona - a mischievous teen who happens to be a shapeshifting creature he's sworn to destroy.

films.t: Nina et le Secret du hérisson
films.syn: Every evening, Nina likes to listen to her father's stories. They imagine a hedgehog discovering the world. One evening, Nina's father is distracted by more important work-related stories. Fortunately, Mehdi is there, Nina's best friend. What if the hidden treasure in the old factory could solve all their problems? Here begins a great adventure where they must escape the clutches of the old neigbour and her cat Touffu, avoid the guardian's traps and outsmart his big dog… They can trust in the little hedgehog to lead the quest by their sides!
Two people are sitting on a bench in Geneva. One, Judith, is a sex worker who talks about her experience with disabled clients. An animated documentary about sex between people who are not in love.
A child plays herself in miniature in a scale model where everything is prettier.
A nun digs a man out of the ground and loses her grip on everyday life. Can secrets and harmony coexist?
Nurit walks us through her journey into motherhood, which begins with a silent birth, continues to fertility treatments, and ends up with fixing the Eilat cemetery, where she finds closure.
As a great tribute to Swiss mechanical watchmaking, "OMEGA Quality Campaign" journeys through the brand's most epic historical events in a magical choreography of tiny precious movements.

films.t: ONI: Thunder God's Tale "Episode 104: The Demon Moon Rises"
films.syn: In a mystical world of Japanese gods and spirits, a courageous girl strives to follow in her mysterious father's footsteps and find her true powers.
A group of children venture beyond the house. They grow up on this particular day in the summer holidays.

The OIAF's signal film uses a technique the director is calling "A Dopey Photo Slop 2.0". Viviane Labelle created the titles using chromatography and Andrew Zukerman created the electroacoustic score.
An Iranian girl unfolds her school memories through the wrinkles and fabrics of her old uniform. She admits that she's nothing but a "female" and explores the roots of this idea in her school years.

aw: Jean-Luc Xiberras Award for a First Film

films.syn: Ozi is an orphaned Orangutan who uses her skills as an influencer to save her world from deforestation. Setting out to find of her parents, she sees her rainforest home is being destroyed. The film encourages a new generation to use their voice to protect our world.
A noisy, hyper-mischievous classroom of 4th graders are caught off-guard as the teacher walks in unannounced, which is followed by a surprise test of creativity and character.
What happens if we leave a building abandoned? We are going to follow life moving through space in a visual and experimental meandering.
Princess Bianca finds out she can get a Prince Charming by kissing the right frog, so she sets out to find one in the garden pond. Albert the hamster isn't happy with the game and becomes jealous.
A small family of shrews lives on the banks of a stream. One day, very heavy rainfall washes away the village. Luckily, the family escapes the worst, but their house is destroyed.

A documentary told from the voices of the "second golden age" of animation in the 1990s and 2000s about the rise, fall and rise again of hand-drawn animation. They were trained by animation masters that created the principles of animation, they took animation to heights no one dreamed of - and then came the computer.
Based on a true story about gender identity, Little League Baseball, the people who inspire change, and the superheroes who allow that change to happen.

films.t: Pharrell feat. 21 Savage & Tyler, The Creator "Cash In Cash Out"
films.syn: This film is in full CGI. The characters and scenes were caricatured to suit a "toy" style. The intention was for the CGI to be photographic to make the viewer question if this was stop-motion or CGI.

In a dystopian future, threatened by their planet's toxicity, immortal asexual biotitans plan their escape. Suddenly, when the calligrapher Krypton sees a forbidden book transform into Gargara, a young impetuous punk, this delicate status quo ruptures. Characterised by expressionism and brutalism, the gifted filmmaker gives us a farcical picaresque adventure in the purest tradition of space opera.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Midnight Specials) - film entry from an earlier edition (archive id 20223105)

films.syn: Bob the plumber is hired to fix a broken pipe and to his surprise he lands in a gay fetish club.
A king and a queen have almost everything, but something is missing. Desperate as they are, they search for the perfect seed to grow a child, but the only thing flourishing is their garden.
When a bruised and battered man claiming to be Santa Claus is arrested for the murder of a child, the interrogating officers uncover a story more bizarre and horrific than expected.
A boy is chasing a mysterious red tail through magical places, uncovering secrets that remind him of his own memories and sadness. What lies ahead on his journey and where will it take him?

aw: Cristal for the Best VR Work

films.syn: The good name of a seemingly regular rabbit falls victim to an unstoppable tide of disinformation.
Human defeated the King of Hell and occupied Hell through numerical superiority. Human redesigned the reincarnation process using high tech, but they overestimated their ability.
Relevo, the "sport's witness", arrives to change the rules, to make the usual different, to be more agile than the rest of the media, to make you understand sports from another point of view.

films.t: Remember How I Used to Ride a White Horse
films.ot: Sjeti se kako sam jahala bijelog konja
films.syn: Time continuously elapses, and apathy can trap consciousness into a loop. Escaping this stagnation one can discover the true beauty of existence.
Andy, followed by a friend filming the scene, goes to his recycling appointment. We follow him through the whole process, until his very last breath.

films.t: Ride on Joyfulness - A Gift for You

films.syn: Dog and Robot are the best friends in the world. One beautiful day they decide to go to the beach, but at the end of the day Robot is all rusty and completely paralysed! His friend, not knowing what to do, leaves him behind. As the seasons pass, Dog tries to find new friends with some success, while Robot has no choice but to dream of more ideal situations.

Rosa is a tiny insecure flower fairy. More than anything she dreams of having a friend, but she is too scared to find one. One day the adventurous butterfly, Silk, crosses paths with Rosa and they immediately become friends. When Silk is kidnapped by an evil Stone Troll, Rosa has to let go of her fears and set out on a journey to save her best friend.
"First there is nothing, then a deep nothingness, and then a blue depth" - Yves Klein quoting Gaston Bachelard. This is a real-time rendered short film fully made from 3D scans all about this quote.
A grandmother living amongst strangers must confront her stubbornly independent nature when she accidentally causes a pot of boiling rice to overflow, which turns into a flood threatening her house.
After being forced to leave everything behind, Saleem, a young boy carrying the burden of his past, stumbles upon a treasure map and embarks on a life-changing adventure!
As a relationship reaches a turning point, one person's fragile understanding of control begins to haunt their dreams.
A troupe of clowns gather to perform a story about a Priest and a refugee but as their misguided tale unfolds, the boundaries between fiction and reality begin to fray.
Samuel has a problem. Samuel is 10 years old and Dimitri has just told Julie, who's older than Samuel, that he is in love. Ok, it's true, but no-one must know, not even his best friend Corentin.
The crew of a damaged deep space freighter are stranded on a beautiful, yet dangerous planet.

aw: Second Jury Award for a TV Series

films.syn: A young girl, seeking reprieve from her days in a rural workhouse, discovers a legendary haunted cave with her friends. The cave's dark pull will change the trajectory of her life forever.
The expression of an emotional desire called love.
You are the second wave of British bombers headed to Copenhagen to bomb the Gestapo's headquarters. But as you approach the city, you realize something isn't right.
In a mysterious forest, a woman is slowly lured into a nostalgic daydream as she observes the butterflies.

Initially, on 1st April 2022, the Shanghai government asked people to stay at home in quarantine for five days, but it reneged on its promise and the city closed for two months. Sun Xun was also quarantined in a hotel. Everyone was unprepared.
Three best friends seek adventure and connection while learning how to navigate each other's differences.

aw: First Jury Award for a TV Series

films.syn: A conversation between a grandmother and her granddaughter through their notebooks and landscape sketches discussing four themes: death, migration, memory and expression.
The search for a tap dance shoe leaves a building topsy-turvy.
To all those who were told they were weird or were made to feel that way. Weird is weird based on a norm, once we lose sight of that rigid norm, weird can be anything and it can be funny, confusing.
Like a single film frame, insects flash for a fraction of a second, only to immediately withdraw from the field of vision again.

films.t: Sirocco and the Kingdom of Air Streams
films.ot: Sirocco et le Royaume des courants d'air
films.syn: Two sisters, 4-year-old Juliette and 8-year-old Carmen, discover a passage between their world and a book’s, "The Kingdom of Air Streams". To come back they need to find Sirocco, a terrifying character who can control the wind.

The tale of a mythical cowboy who appears in a corrupt logging town (circa 1940s) and with the aid of his slide guitar and a giant Hellbug, he's able to battle the evil Mayor and his equally selfish twin brother to clean up the logging town of Sourdough Creek.
This depicts the end of the Anthropocene epoch - the epoch of human beings - and the beginning of a new one.
A boy, Daniel, travels by train towards a dark destination known as the smokehouse.
In a humid and warm place, I existed. The whitewashed "gender selection" takes place in two different spaces, where satisfaction and despair mingle.
Aaron, a military drone pilot, recalls an air mission to monitor an oil field. During a flight, his drone encounters a magnificent eagle guided by its breeder Azad, who lives in the desert.
A little girl stumbles into a sacred grove near her village in South India. She disturbs the spirit of the forest, who takes her on an adventure to illuminate the origins of this ancient swampland.
"It's walking without any muscles, though it shouldn't be able to walk. Stone tissue. How strange," said the girl and looked at her boneless body.
In Durban 2050, two best friends risk everything to illegally surf colossal, deadly waves.
A visual reflection on getting out of a harmful relationship and moving on.
The history of the Cultural Revolution in China in the 1960s… from the perspective of a mango… from a factory.

films.t: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutant Mayhem
films.syn: After years of being sheltered from the human world, the Turtle brothers set out to win the hearts of New Yorkers and be accepted as normal teenagers through heroic acts. Their new friend April O’Neil helps them take on a mysterious crime syndicate, but they soon get in over their heads when an army of mutants is unleashed upon them.
On the vast salt flats under dark clouds, a hole in the ground swallows the memory of a woman that Telsche longs to see again.

Juanjo is an asthmatic boy who has been protected by his family to the point where it is suffocating. Miquel is growing up in a family with an absent father, whose mother tries to get by, but does not always succeed. A tale about Juanjo and Miquel's relationship, two teenage boys from Barcelona in 1991 who take refuge in their friendship and music to escape from the grey world they live in.
Entirely hand-painted frame-by-frame with oils, Em Cooper's music video for The Beatles explores the space between dreaming and wakefulness.

aw: Jury Award for a Commissioned Film

films.syn: A man finds himself paralyzed in a remote and hostile environment after an accident. His situation takes on new directions as he accepts his new reality.

In 1900, a modern family from Boston moves into their recently purchased, stately country home, Canterville Chase in England, only to find it is haunted by a ghost. The ghost, Sir Simon de Canterville, who has been haunting the place successfully for over three hundred years, meets his match when he tries to scare out the American family.

Akino is a trainee concierge at the Arctic Department Store, an unusual department store that caters exclusively to animals. Under the watchful eyes of the floor manager and senior concierges, Akino runs around to fulfill the wishes of customers with a myriad of needs and problems in her pursuit to become a full-fledged concierge.
The crowd is untruth.
If the rain were to fall indoors, but never outdoors - where would we begin to look for shelter? The school bell would ring, but no one would hear it.
A creature attends a feast hosted by a magic fridge. So begins his downfall through a spiral of unbridled food consumption. Corrupted and transformed into a beast, he faces a macabre last course.

Born and raised in Okinawa, Ryota has a brother Sota who is 3 years older than him. Like Sota, Ryota gets addicted to playing basketball. In high school, Ryota plays with the Shohoku basketball team and is about to challenge the defending champions, Sannoh Kogyo, at the National Championship.
Leave or stay? Director Denis Do takes us on an existential quest through the generations of a single family shaken by 200 years of Chinese history. A deeply humanistic family chronicle.
A boy fantasizes about becoming a famous footballer, playing in big stadiums, but first he has to win a match in a small backyard playing against a goose.
"The Harbourmaster" tells the true story of its titular swan and of how he went from a beloved small town icon to a wanted criminal.

A fun buddy movie following the misadventures of two unlikely friends - a runaway puppet with a boundless imagination and an abandoned stuffed toy animal in need of a friend. They cross paths in Central Park and against all odds pair up for an epic adventure in New York City.

The insatiably curious and headstrong inventor Leonardo da Vinci leaves Italy and Pope Leon X to join the French court, where he can experiment freely, inventing flying contraptions, incredible machines and studying the human body. Embark on a journey with the greatest genius of all time inspired by the life and times of Leonardo da Vinci.
The Miracle, a place where the sun always shines, there's endless opportunities to relax and food is in abundance.

On the edge of a mangrove, a group of girls lives to the rhythm of the climate and the wild geese around them. They see each other live and grow up at different ages. As time passes, tensions arise and rivalries develop.

At the heart of Africa, a king is poisoned by one of his subjects. An old seer is called to the rescue. Contrary to their expectations, he suggests that two of the palace's close aids go to the sacred cave to look for an antidote to cure the King of Mabunos.

films.t: The Sandman "A Dream of a Thousand Cats"
films.syn: A young couple's kitten is coerced by a strange brown cat to leave the bed of her human owners and attend a speech by a feline prophet, a purebred Siamese. The speaker regales a congregation of cats with a tale of a dream she had after her cruel owners drowned her kittens in a lake.
When a world-famous film star is accused of eating his female co-stars, his career goes down the drain. That wipes the smile off his face!

A little soldier meets the devil and trades his violin against Satan's promise of good fortune. The devil changes his mask all the time: butterfly collector, radio announcer, photographer, masseur in a sauna. The little soldier on leave… Stravinsky's music sets the pace, with a judicious mixture of jazz, church music, tango, waltz and ragtime.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Annecy Classics) - film entry from an earlier edition (archive id 850383)

films.syn: Explore the world through the eyes and ears of a tiny Sound Collector.

films.t: The Spider Within: A Spider-Verse Story
films.syn: Miles Morales struggles to balance his responsibilities as a teenager, friend, and student while acting as Brooklyn's only Spider-Man. After a challenging day living with these pressures, Miles experiences a panic attack that forces him to confront his anxiety and learn that reaching out for help can be just as brave an act as protecting his city.
The lead dancer from a famous cabaret with Imperial renown, uses her unique skill set to spy for the Rebellion, but the presence of a mysterious officer threatens to derail her mission.

What is The Transient? It is that fleeting moment when you question what you are seeing when the uncanny valley takes over and when harmonious wildlife is revealed as an obsessive manipulation of nature.

films.t: The Tunnel to Summer, the Exit of Goodbyes
films.syn: The Urashima Tunnel grants a wish to those who enter... but at a price. Kaoru and Anzu, with two very different pasts and personalities, team up to investigate the mysterious tunnel.

When three pre-teen boys and an older brother and his girlfriend take off for a weekend campout, none of them could imagine the horrors (and laughs) awaiting them in a remote desert inhabited by a legendary night creature. Puberty and adventure await, along with terror, amputations and a tightening web of conspiratorial local townsfolk!
A courageous arborist Beth and her colleagues spend an exhausting night in the middle of the countryside trying at all costs to save their orchards from the destructive frost.
Theodore Ushev, the auteur behind a number of renowned animated shorts, reveals his inner universe, formed by half a century of personal experience acquired in a constantly changing world.
In the heart of Newtown, Sydney, the summer brings all sorts of people out. As night falls, everyone comes together to relish in the revival of social drinking after the lasting impacts of Covid-19.
A tourist struggles to get through a mass of crowds that grow larger and more chaotic with each loop cycle they go through, until they form a cacophony of sound and colour.

Somewhere in outer space, a strange vehicle crash-lands on planet Perdide. Claude, the pilot, is injured, but he's able to warn his friend Jaffar and tell his little son Piel to flee to the hills before the dreaded hornets attack. Hidden in the undergrowth, Piel's only means of communication is a microphone linked to Jaffar's spaceship. Restored in 4K by CITE FILMS in collaboration with the Fondazione Cineteca di Bologne and with the help to digitalization from the CNC.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Annecy Classics) - film entry from an earlier edition (archive id 821020)

films.syn: Old, dark memories are drawn onto stardust. Either I condemn you, or I free you from your agony.
Animated version of a famous Hungarian epic tale by János Arany.
One summer day, a quiet boy, who is playing on a local baseball team, has a strange experience.
Tired of being talked at by men, a woman decides to liberate his tongue.

films.t: Tony, Shelly and the Magic Light
films.syn: 11-year-old Tony has a unique feature he was born with - he glows. He spends his days at home in his blanket bunker and dreams about having a friend. Before Christmas, a peculiar girl named Shelly moves into his house and turns his world upside down. Together, they embark on an adventurous search for the origin of the mysterious tufts of darkness which suck the sunshine out of their house.
The true story of Ignazio Cutrò and his family, who were threatened by the mafia and isolated by friends because they chose to speak out. Despite everything, they still live in Sicily today.
Set during school, this is a story about boys who physically show their lack of understanding about someone who is different and who push this particular behavior to the limit.
Surely it's a fantasy, like a mirage.
At nightfall, a child escapes from his home to discover an unknown world. His journey will take him inside a new silent, empty house.

A man is waiting for test results. He expects the worst but at the same time hopes for the best. Distressed and afraid he spends a week in a limbo of his own creation, neither here nor there, dreading what the outcome might be.

films.ot: Wat zit er in die kist?
films.syn: "What's in That Crate?" wondered the captain, bus driver and postman as they transported their cargo. The journey takes them overland, across the sea and in the air before the secret is revealed.
While slugs slither aimlessly across the kitchen floor, Noémie composes a moving and fragmented self-portrait, on the fringes between intimacy and the world's hubbub.

Adam is a 15-year-old teenager who has a special quirk - his body changes in reaction to mockery and negative comments he receives from those around him. The accumulation of his physical changes only adds an extra layer of complexity to those already present in his life.
Seeking a way out of depression, Lara tries using other people's experiences, but she only finds the key when she finds a real connection to herself.
In a world devoid of its inhabitants, one person is left still trying to live like before.
A big-headed baby, one of the numerous victims of the white melamine-tainted milk powder incidents caused by the Sanlu (Three Deer) Group Co. Ltd in China, sinks into the abyss of horror and despair.

2123. Faced with diminishing resources, the human race can only survive through a trade-off: at the age of 50, every citizen is gradually turned into a tree. When Stefan discovers that his beloved wife Nora has voluntarily signed up for donating her own body before her time, he sets out on an adventurous journey to save her at all costs.

A starry-eyed goat decides to build a cabin in the jungle to live there, but this means she'll be sharing with some dangerous neighbours. The goat manages to make new friends, but it comes at a heavy price.
A natural history fantasy film following the dramatic life cycle of the Salmon, from the river to sea and back, portraying the fish in human form.
Mother and Father lay the child in his cot at the same time every night. However, come morning, only a shallow crater remains - a baby-shaped depression. The boy was destined to be a wanderer.
A heart-wrenching story that for the first time combines stop-motion animation with the destructive and remorseless powers of real fire.

films.t: Your Pretty Face Is Going to Hell: The Cartoon "Ouroboros"
films.syn: Beliked cult series "Your Pretty Face is Going to Hell" returns in animated form. Join Gary, Satan and all your favorite demons as they make the world a worse place one sinner at a time.

films.t: "Federal Owl Commission": OIAF 23 Festival Signal Film
films.syn: A demented parody of the Canadian government’s trailer for OIAF 23.

A punk rock opera featuring all new songs by Vancouver-based band, Rare Americans. Set in 1993, in the City of Champions, it follows a group of disaffected teens trying to navigate their last year of high school while questioning their roots and questioning the truth.
Butterflies, frogs and flies celebrate love in all its colors in the trailer for the 14th Anibar Animation Festival in Kosovo.
A seed, cradled in the embrace of potential, whispers tales of a destiny unknown. With tender care, we cultivate its essence, birthing not just a tree, but a legacy of dreams.
All about the journey of M, a post-traumatic secret agent, on his mission to return six missing agents from a mysterious shaman.
[S] is a loop that exposes the lifespan of infinity. The film delves into an immersive loop of organic forms, reflecting on the entangled nature of life and art.

aw: Jean-Luc Xiberras Award for a First Film

films.syn: Displaced by the Second World War, a troop of Polish soldiers find an inseparable bond through an orphaned bear they name Wojtek.

In the early 1950s, on the banks of the River Marne, François, a young 11-year-old boy, is intrigued to discover that his parents are building a boat in their little garden, a replica of the famous sailor Joshua Slocum’s sailboat. As the years go by, in post-war France, François drifts from adolescence to adulthood. While the boat is being built, and with a tender and poetic look at his mother and father, the young boy embarks on his own adventure, one that will take him down his own passionate route of the sea and drawing.
To protect the woman she loves, V is forced to flee her homeland, Congo. She embarks on the dangerous journey to the USA, only to be cruelly stripped of the few belongings that she carries.
This project moves sound and image using wind movements. It shows the alteration of spectrograms with these motion vectors and applies a sound resynthesis.
Out hunting one day in rural Spain, a father struggles to accept that his adult son is moving abroad and is dealing with feelings of being left alone.
In a picturesque field, a cat pursues a fly in an epic mental battle. Astonishing transformations lead the cat to overcome the virus, capture the fly, and conclude with a strange grooming session.

films.t: Adult Swim Off the Air "Magic Buzz"
films.syn: The vibrations of an abandoned phone in the woods set off a tiny fairy-rave. Produced for Adult Swim off the Air in close collaboration with musician Xav Clarke.
A magical insight into the very individual thoughts of Alice, our adorable, quirky and highly imaginative little girl who tries to understand the world through her own art.
This impactful film brings home the importance of Alzheimer's Research UK's mission to find a cure and urges the British public to stand with them and support their revolutionary research.
After the cannibal killer Logan Miller was arrested, several VHS tapes were found revealing the horrific abduction and murder of a young woman in Missouri.
A woman's ability to give birth to marine creatures is exploited for commercial purposes.
A stunned crowd confronts a fire. The threat has no name, and a feeling of anxiety is spreading. They must find a purpose for it.
Ashnikko in a monster truck and a squad of develish beasts ride towards the sunset to battle the angelic overlord robots.

films.t: Astérix and Obélix, The Big Fight
films.ot: Astérix et Obélix, le Combat des chefs

films.syn: Erased from history, brought back to life. This 3-part docu series revives Belgian's hidden past. From the atomic bomb to XTC-production and the fraudulent start of mass tourism. It's not pretty.

Every morning, Boris the village baker makes a fresh batch of crusty bread and pastries for all his neighbours until… Achoo! He can't stop sneezing. He has become allergic to flour, how will he be able to supply the village?

Two brothers are on a fun adventure in the outdoors when it takes a sombre twist after a haunting dream exposes the consequences. Their quest navigates environmental consciousness and the pursuit of redemption.
Three balding brothers travel to Istanbul to get a hair transplant. Stuck with each other in a hotel far from home, their insecurities grow faster than their hair.

films.t: Behind the Beats "Salsa Meets R&B: A Story of Latin Pop (Featuring Kali Uchis)"
films.syn: Latin Pop comes from the fusion of R&B and Salsa, and what a fusion! In this episode, we take a look at one of this movement’s pioneers and how she perfected it to be able to soar up the charts.
Watch Eel and friends brighten this fun world, interact under the sea with their funny gadgets. This technology is only made possible with Belong, a broadband internet and sim plan database company.
An animated journey through a young woman's diary entries, notes and drawings.
Crossing through darkness towards the light.

Lobuin, Vanesa and Soma are three women from very different parts of the world who face the same problem: climate change. They will lose everything because of the effects of global warming and they will be forced to emigrate to survive.

A woman is getting ready for a date but suddenly finds herself transported into a psychedelic world depicting the hardships of being a woman. Here, she confronts symbols of social pressure to embrace her femininity.
Everything changes when the oil company launches a violent attack on its community, so Carmen and Luis try to escape.

films.t: Blue Eye Samurai "The Tale of the Ronin and the Bride"
films.syn: Set in the Edo-period in Japan, follow Mizu, a mixed-race master of the sword who lives a life in disguise seeking deliverance through revenge.

films.t: Blue Lock the Movie: Episode Nagi
films.syn: "C'est pénible." C'est la phrase fétiche de Nagi Seishiro, lycéen en deuxième année, tandis qu'il vit sa morne vie. Jusqu'à ce que Mikage Reo, un camarade de classe qui rêve de gagner la Coupe du monde, ne découvre le talent caché de Nagi et l'incite à jouer au football et à partager son incroyable don. Un jour, il reçoit une invitation au mystérieux projet Blue Lock. Une rencontre avec les meilleurs attaquants du pays l'y attend. Le rêve de Nagi de devenir le meilleur, aux côtés de Reo, va propulser le jeune prodige dans un monde qu'il n'a jamais connu.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Annecy Présente 2024) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: En 1886 en Amérique, Mary et Tom, une sœur et un frère âgés de 9 ans et 12 ans, arrivent dans la cohue new-yorkaise à bord d'un paquebot. Ils sont là pour rencontrer leur oncle Niall et assurer leur héritage. Mais quand Oncle Niall manque leur rendez-vous, ils décident d'embarquer sur le Transcontinental dans l'espoir de parvenir jusqu'en Californie pour le retrouver.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Annecy Présente 2024) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: A man is swimming in the sea. As he does, memories rise to the surface. From his early childhood to his life as a man, all his memories are linked to water. Some are happy, some glorious, some traumatic.
A mother and son navigate their lust and loneliness in the queerest of ways.
An animated logo from the Chantelouve production company symbolising the power of transformation and freedom, inspired by the Greco-Roman mythical she-wolf.
John asks Barbarella to dance. Barbarella has a strange premonition: that insatiable hunger has returned. As their bestiality takes control, the two lovers devour each other under the stars.

films.t: Chinese Man feat. Stogie T, KT Gorique & FP "Too Late"
films.syn: The accompanying video, directed by Victor Haegelin, uses the stop-motion technique to create a colourful, poetic world. The characters are on a hamster wheel symbolising the perpetuity of life with all its turmoil.
The girl draws a circle on the ground. Passers-by step into it, one by one. Soon the circle is full of people, struggling to stay inside.

Andrew, a young movie buff, can’t stop criticising a horror movie from the 80s he is watching. The film’s star assassin mysteriously overhears Andrew's comments and reaches out and grabs him through the screen.
A FUNtastic children's musical without dialogue whose idea came from Hungarian twin brothers when they were 10 years old.
One dancer, one body, one phone. In a time of collective alienation and technological mass control, one woman rediscovers her soul and reclaims her mind.

Tao is a thing, but it is only in a trance. In a trance, there is an image in it. In a trance, there is an object in it. The metaverse may be an infinite idea, a fuzzy cube, a house to live in, or other life forms. Infinite possibilities of regeneration.

From Executive Producer and Writer James Gunn, "Creature Commandos" is the upcoming Max Original animated event series, based on DC characters and produced by DC Studios and Warner Bros. Animation, which follows Amanda Waller as she forms a black ops team out of monstrous prisoners. Prepare for an in-depth look from Rick Morales (Supervising Producer) and Balak Yves (Supervising Director) into the artistry and creative processes behind this highly anticipated series kicking off a new era of storytelling in the DC Universe.
In a cabin deep in the woods by a lake, a girl and her ailing grandpa are awaiting Death. She is planning to defy and slay the strange entity.
In a frenzied choreography, Célestin speaks to us about the urgent need to save his mother yeti, while black figures dance, consume and mistreat her under the animals’ helpless gaze.
Algorithmic typhoons turn images into zombie-like entities enslaved by society. However, these images do not seek to rebel, they simply long to dream of eternal life in a disposable world.

Gru, Lucy, Margo, Edith, and Agnes welcome a new member to the family, Gru Jr., who is intent on tormenting his dad. Gru faces a new nemesis in Maxime Le Mal and his girlfriend Valentina, and the family is forced to go on the run.

Le petit dinosaure Diplodocus rêve de vivre une grande aventure. Malheureusement, ses parents surprotecteurs ne le laissent pas explorer le monde magnifique mais dangereux au-delà du mur qu'ils ont construit pour protéger leur foyer dans la jungle. Diplo ne sait pas encore que son univers fait en réalité partie d'une bande dessinée créée par Ted, un artiste rêvant de succès.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Annecy Présente 2024) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: This is a festival promo for DOA, a Norwegian festival for short-format animation. The smile is the festival's logo.
A man searches for an answer.

films.t: Détective Conan : L'Étoile à 1 million de dollars
films.syn: Hakodate, région d'Hokkaido. Une carte de Kaito Kid est retrouvée dans les entrepôts du groupe Onoe. En même temps, un cadavre tailladé d'une croix à la poitrine est découvert dans le quartier des entrepôts de Hakodate. La piste mène l'enquête au "vendeur de mort", un Américain d'origine japonaise opérant comme marchand d'armes dans le bassin asiatique. Place à une chasse au trésor épique !

ap.sel: Officially selected (Annecy Présente 2024) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: Strange places take shape in a torch’s beam of light and the sound of water droplets hitting the ground punctuates our footsteps. In the distance, we hear muffled music, where does it come from?
Portraying the personal experience of a fatal loss, it leads us on a journey through phantasmagoric realms, oscillating between shadow and light, past and present, sorrow and solace.
Who is Elene Dariani? Is she a mystification by poet Paolo, or a woman who found herself in his shadow? The film is based on a real poetic love story.
A virtual reality interactive and narrative experience that invites the user to travel inside the brain of a father who is suffering from aphasia.
This photographic exploration of family photo albums ravaged by water evokes hazy and indistinct memories, poignant witnesses of a fragile past.

A doctor-turned-priest, Father Park was excommunicated for performing exorcisms by a church that refused to believe in the supernatural beings preying on the innocent. When his long-time friend, a monk from a secretive and magic-wielding temple, calls upon him to protect a naïve yet powerful child from his corrupt master.
Un jeune garçon passionné par les superhéros rencontre un tigre du Bengale et décide d'aider le magnifique animal à échapper aux chasseurs qui veulent le capturer.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Annecy Présente 2024) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: Photographic images, scenes of everyday life. Connected together, a new landscape emerges.
Feral Child teamed up with agency Jung Von Matt Donau and live action director Ross Cooper to direct this "Roger Rabbit" inspired spot for the Austrian Federal Ministry for Climate Protection.

A cat wakes up in a world covered in water, where the entire human race seems to have disappeared. He seeks refuge on a boat with a group of other animals. But getting along with them proves to be an even greater challenge than overcoming his fear of water! Everyone will need to learn to overcome their differences and adapt to this new world they find themselves in.
An invitation for you to surrender to the whims of the wind on a seemingly ordinary day, concealing within its turbulence a captivating night in the life of a woman.
Girls have been cultivated like flowers for generations. We need more growing seasons to breed new ways into the system.

films.t: Fox and Hare Save the Forest
films.syn: Il se passe des choses étranges dans la forêt ! Hibou a disparu, des rats malicieux terrorisent le voisinage et un lac déborde, menaçant les maisons des habitants de la forêt. Serait-ce l'œuvre d'un castor mégalomane ? Renard et Lapine sont bien décidés à le découvrir. Ils doivent retrouver Hibou et sauver la situation. Leur amitié sera mise à rude épreuve !

ap.sel: Officially selected (Annecy Présente 2024) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: A chicken rescue mission gone wrong leads the activists into a dangerous wilderness where they experience situations that lead to new insights such as, nature is not a safe place for animals.
An irritable gargoyle spends 800 years stuck on the side of a cathedral with a decorative metal rain gutter as the world changes for better and for worse.

aw: Cristal for the Best VR Work

films.syn: 11-year-old Karin is abandoned by her father at her grandfather’s house, the monk of a small town in the Japanese countryside. Her grandfather asks Anzu, his jovial, helpful, although rather capricious, ghost-cat to look after her. The clash of their strong characters causes sparks, at least at the beginning.
With humor and sensitivity, Gigi tells us about her gender transition from the tormented little mermaid to the fulfilled woman she is today.

A boy called Gon was on the verge of death, when suddenly gills started to grow and he could breathe again. Kang Ha and his grandpa rescue Gon and together they become an odd family. This film explores life's paradoxes, blessings and curses. It will encourage you to think about your own "gills" to help you get through your life.
Pinocchio felt a longing deep within him. Someday, he would become a real girl and live a life beyond the confines of make-believe.
A boy struggles to save a plant in a barren desert. A man loves a woman who doesn't love him back, and the mare who fell during the night can't be saved.

Adpaté de"Ganbatte Ikimasshoi" de Yoshiko Shikimura. Une lycéenne, Etsuko, passe des journées sans but jusqu'au jour où Riina, une nouvelle élève, demande son aide pour créer un club d'aviron. Bien qu'Etsuko n'accepte qu'à contrecœur après avoir écouté Riina parler avec passion de son rêve, elle commence peu à peu à aimer le club en passant du temps avec ses coéquipières.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Annecy Présente 2024) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: A sonic-video work, a disruptive immersive experience. It’s a glass Tower of Babel, a beautiful hypnotic kaleidoscope. It’s a feeling of both attraction and repulsion, inspired by sci-fi books.

films.t: GODS ft. NewJeans "Worlds 2023 Anthem – League of Legends"
films.syn: This is the story of an unbreakable spirit and the unbending heart of a champion. The official anthem and music video for League of Legends World Championship 2023.
Many grains make a cloud. Many clouds form an atmosphere. An exploration of the perception of time through the eyes and ears.

Alfonso, a young squirrel, always has his head in the clouds. He loves watching them and sometimes takes snapshots of them. But cloud-gazing is not always easy. Sometimes, he even has to be really brave.
Sea, sun, beaches and family holidays. But what if the hotel isn't as stellar as promised, your room has a bit of a naughty view, the dinner is surprisingly exotic and your luggage travels elsewhere?
I’ve practiced these words for 20 years now, but maybe being candid isn’t the best idea. I’m starting my countdown again, another 20 years. Maybe the time will be right by then.
"Only yesterday, these ice dragons ruled the valleys, destroying everything in their path. We cursed them in vain. And today, it makes you wonder if we should have prayed a little less."

This is the story about a little girl who is different. Her world is Coyoacán in Mexico. Sparkling and vibrant, everything interests her. And when life’s trials and tribulations come her way, she faces them with her overflowing imagination. This little girl is called Frida Kahlo!
A young Nubian girl embarks on a journey back in time to reconnect with her drowned homeland.
Painterly impressions of a horse’s silhouette, its springy movements, the shape of its head, the fight of stallions.
A reimagination of Hulu's logo, part of the second wave of the Hulu ID project.
Humantises are masters of deception, but can they hide from change. When one Humantis unexpectedly goes through a physical transformation, it struggles to adapt and grow into its new self.

Hurikán rushes out to save his favourite beer stand from closure by fetching a new keg to impress the bartender he has a crush on. In a wild Prague district, he faces robbers, cops, and his own thirst. Despite getting the keg, he succumbs to temptation.

One day, when the reserve near his house is on fire, Pedro finds a scared dog and takes her home. It isn’t easy to convince his parents but, in the end, Kuky stays. Since then, they have become best friends.

24th February 2022, my boyfriend and I fled Kyiv to go to Irpin. We spent 10 days in a blockaded city and just managed to escape with the last evacuation convoy. Time passed, but the feeling that I died in Irpin has never left me since.
Despite their disinterest, a young child tries to convince her local community she wants to become a statue, bringing her on surreal voyage towards the garish monolith that lingers in the background.
A journey of a young woman metamorphosing into another and trying to tame her new self.
NPR's third-most popular host, Lauren Caspian, a well-meaning, hypocritical nimrod puppet, conducts in-depth interviews with real-world human guests.

films.t: In the Shadow of the Cypress
films.ot: Dar Saaye Sarv (In the Shadow of the Cypress)
films.syn: A captain suffering from PTSD lives with his daughter and struggles with a harsh life. One day, something unexpected happens. It can be either more trouble or a blessing in disguise.

We return to the mind of newly minted teenager Riley just as headquarters is undergoing a sudden demolition to make room for something entirely unexpected: new Emotions! Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear and Disgust, who’ve long been running a successful operation by all accounts, aren’t sure how to feel when Anxiety shows up. And it looks like she’s not alone.
Short films are like pasta! They come in many forms, each culture has its own specialties, everyone likes them. This year's INTERFILM trailer celebrates a high-carb short film diet. Bon appétit!

10-year-old Angelo dreams of being an adventurer and explorer. Until one day, in the car with his family on their way to visit his beloved Granny, who is very ill, he is suddenly forced to show the extent of his bravery: he is left behind by mistake at the motorway services. Angelo decides to take a shortcut through the forest to reach his Granny’s house. He finds himself in a mysterious land inhabited by strange beings threatened by an enemy even worse than the local ogre.

films.t: Is This Now the Time I Should Let You Go?
films.syn: Like the scenery from a running train, memories are beautiful, blurry and keep changing. A daughter expresses the feelings of losing her father by mixing video footage and analog film with animation.
As she gets older, Oma’s perception begins to change. While her daughter tries to adapt to her new situation, she seems to sink deeper and deeper into herself.
Joko supports his family but faces humiliation when forced to carry city notables on his back, leading to a struggle between dignity and the lure of money in a tale of domination.

A seemingly idyllic lovers' encounter reveals itself to be the start of a genderless figure's surreal odyssey. A dystopian universe unfolds piece by piece as the character learns who they really are. The story reflects on what makes humans human in a technological age. Netzhammer's feature debut takes an unsparing look at both present and future.
This music video celebrates hip-hop’s 50th anniversary. This tribute charts its evolution from the streets of New York to worldwide fame, following the Sugarhill Gang and the rise of hip-hop culture.
Joanna, a young European traveller, roams around the Cape Verde Islands with her sketchbook. On her journey she encounters Lito, a local fisherman, who will encourage her to delay her departure.
"Kawauso" refers to the Japanese otter. The girl meets a Japanese otter and they try to communicate but it doesn't work. This is because Japanese otters are extinct and no one can touch the girl.

At the bottom of the sea, between the rocks and coral, primitive seaweed gently sways, lulled by the muffled sound of rolling currents. High above on the surface of the water, something extraordinary has just appeared: a voice.
A man's desire for a beautiful stranger leads him down a dark and dangerous path, where he discovers a terrifying secret lurking beneath the surface as he searches for the woman who stole his heart.

Dans une atmosphère festive et féérique, des animaux du monde entier sont rassemblés au travers de cinq aventures, avec poésie et légèreté, pour célébrer Noël et l'hiver. Ils vont ainsi apprendre la valeur de l'entraide, de la générosité et redécouvrir la beauté de la Nature.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Annecy Présente 2024) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: La Fatiha est la première sourate du Coran. Dans la tradition musulmane, c'est aussi le nom qu'on utilise pour la cérémonie d'hommage à un défunt. Aujourd'hui, c'est la fatiha d'Amir, le père de Feurat Alani, journaliste français et irakien. L'occasion pour ses proches de revenir sur l'histoire d'Amir, et pour Feurat de revenir sur sa propre histoire et celle de l'Irak.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Annecy Présente 2024) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: An aggressive battle between red and dark blue unfolds. The borderlines between the colors vibrate with tension as they fight for their lives.

12-year-old Ben has just hit puberty and suddenly his weight's a problem – for him and for everyone else. The other kids bully him, his divorced parents don't know what to do. Even the school nurse is worried about him. So, despite his love of food and his emerging talent as a chef, Ben decides to take drastic action. He goes on a diet.

films.t: Lola et le Piano à bruits
films.syn: Lola, 11, is sister to 5-year-old Simon, who lives in a world of his own. By observing him, she notices how sensitive he is to small, hidden sounds. With her friend Rolih, they decide to build a noise machine to communicate with him.

aw: Jury Award for a TV Special

films.syn: La trop confiante Fujino et la renfermée Kyomoto ne pourraient pas être plus différentes. Leur passion pour le dessin de manga est la seule chose qui lie ces deux filles que tout oppose. Cependant, un jour, quelque chose survient et fait tout éclater. Une histoire déchirante et marquante sur le fait de grandir.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Annecy Présente 2024) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: A rural family of four faces challenges as the parents prepare for dinner after a joyful day. An argument unfolds in front of their children, escalating to unbearable vehemence.

Leipzig, 1989. Margarethe, a young punk opposed to the East German regime, is detained in a psychiatric hospital. She dreams of breaking out to join the man she loves – a punk musician named Heinrich.
Faced with boredom in the confinement of a one-bedroom apartment, a curious cat explores the fast life of the city as an attempt to break the dreary reality of a daily routine.
When we fall in love, we have no choice but to embrace our emotions, even if only through the absurd and surreal logic of our dreams.
Three rebellious teenage daughters, a restless mother, a father struggling with potatoes, and maybe some elephants, find themselves in Nairobi. What could possibly go wrong?

Grace Pudel is a lonely misfit with an affinity for collecting ornamental snails and an intense love for books. At a young age, when Grace is separated from her fire-breathing twin brother Gilbert, she falls into a spiral of anxiety and angst. Despite a continued series of hardships, inspiration and hope emerge when she strikes up an enduring friendship with an elderly eccentric woman named Pinky, who is full of grit and lust for life. From Academy Award-winning animation writer and director Adam Elliot, Memoir of a Snail is a poignant, heartfelt, hilarious chronicle of the life of an outsider finding her confidence and silver linings amongst the clutter of everyday life.
Beavis and Butt-Head are invited to sleep over at Cody's when his parents mistakenly think they're good friends.
A woman tries to find a place to fit into a weird world full of containers and eventually feels whole again.

Inspired by Henri Michaux’s poems and drawings about his experience with mescaline, "Miserable Miracle" explores the limits of language and perception, creating connections between sound, meaning, line and movement.

Walt Disney Animation Studios will be gracing this year’s edition with a sneak peek of its upcoming theatrical release,"Moana 2", presented by the film’s director, Dave Derrick Jr., and co-director, Jason Hand. A highly anticipated sequel to "Moana", the studios’ latest epic animated musical reunites Moana and Maui three years later for an expansive new voyage alongside a crew of unlikely seafarers.

Marguerite experiences a triple loss: her mother who dies in childbirth, the dog she inherits, and then her nanny, who her father lets go. Alone after these losses, she finds solace in nature at Mont Noir, which shapes her path to becoming a writer.
The film is inspired by Slovenian band Laibach’s music and their song "Moral Support". Through artistic movements it evokes traces of the 20th century’s first few decades.
Tiny people wander across an endless waterscape and move mountains.
What lives in a lonely boy’s ear? And why a boy’s ear? The boy who grew up as a man set out on a journey to collect lonely voices again. What would he eventually find there?

films.ot: La Vie de château "Le Fantôme de Versailles"
films.syn: Malcolm wants Régis and Olga to fall in love, but Violette has a more important mission: to find her missing mouse. In Versailles' secret nooks, she has an unexpected encounter: Louis XIV himself.

aw: Jury Award for a TV Series

films.syn: A VR interactive animated short film inviting the viewer to play a spirit accompanying a grandmother during her last moments. A fantastic journey along the Tree of Life between the present in hospital and vivid memories.
Naraka Asian Games is a battle royale and whether it's squash, cricket, sepaktakraw, skateboarding, dragon boat, breakdancing, kabaddi, ju-jitsu, kurash or wushu, just pick your game.

films.t: Next on Netflix Animation: From "Twilight of the Gods" to "Wallace & Gromit"

films.syn: In the pool changing room, Anthony realizes he has forgotten to bring his swim trunks. Swimming class is about to begin and he needs to find a solution.
Taking inspiration from 20th century avant-garde experiments in graphical sound generation, the entire image in "O/S" functions as an optical soundtrack. Abstract motion becomes sound.

This VR fable immerses us in the peaceful life of Oto and Skippy on their planet, which is then disrupted by a spaceship collision and cosmonaut Exo emerges. Cohabitation between them proves to be tricky.

Nicholas is a psychoanalyst who has Alzheimer's disease. When he gets confused in one of his notes, he ends up creating a situation that will unite one of his patients (Daniel) with his daughter (Monica). The fact that they are both married is only the beginning of a series of confusions that will have a surprising outcome.

Algiers, 1955. One day at the market, Khadidja’s older brother Malek is arrested by the police. From their little hut in the Casbah, Khadidja and her friends Lyes, Philippe and Ahmed are going to do everything they can to find him.

Des forces obscures planifient de kidnapper les héritiers royaux pour forcer le prince à céder son trône à un magicien diabolique. À la rescousse, vient Arthur... un ado-chèvre de 17 ans, immature et beaucoup trop ambitieux !

ap.sel: Officially selected (Annecy Présente 2024) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: Pang est un jeune panda qui grandit dans un village idyllique au cœur de la Chine. Mais lorsque sa meilleure amie, Jielong la "dragonne", est enlevée pour être offerte en présent à un jeune roi lion capricieux, Pang n'hésite pas une seconde : il embarque dans une aventure qui va le mener jusqu'en Afrique !

ap.sel: Officially selected (Annecy Présente 2024) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: In 1990s Hungary, travel is finally possible but unaffordable. By forging international train tickets, three young men make it possible for a whole generation to experience the outside world.
With the sea and urban Algarve as the backdrop, we follow a complete life cycle of a special shellfish called percebes, the goose barnacle.
What am I? Who am I? Why am I here? Official opener for Pictoplasma 2023.
