On 25th July 2020, the bulk carrier MV Wakashio, with 3,800 tonnes of fuel oil, ran aground off the East coast of Mauritius. Twelve days later, the oil spilled onto the coral reefs, causing the worst ecological disaster ever to occur in the region.
A pig wanting to be a human is ready to give it his all, whatever the cost. A human wanting to be an animal is ready to give up everything.
Like every year, the swifts are returning to their homes in the "sleeping districts". This time, they don't find any humans. The space is filled with spirits.

films.t: Pip and Posy Let's Learn "All About Butterflies"
films.syn: This series teaches key curriculum targets to 3-5-year-olds in fun and inventive ways. Viewers play with Pip, Posy and their friends as they use their amazing sense of fun to learn!
Opening titles for Playgrounds In Motion, a brand new animation and motion design festival held in London and Rotterdam.

West Africa, early 1960s. A French officer is assigned to find a missing missionary. His investigation, amid mistrust, silence and prejudice, takes him far away from the glittering shoreline, where day and night become one.

films.t: Pokemon Concierge "Episode 2: What's on Your Mind"
films.syn: Follow Haru, a new concierge, who takes care of the Pokémon alongside the experienced senior staff. As she learns how to make her guests happy, she also embarks on a journey of adventure, friendship and self-discovery.
Princess Sophie and her maid Jessica prepare for a new day in the royal court. Sophie's struggle to play her role propels the two protagonists forward and backward in time.
Pubert Jimbob, a young man, enters a strange reality after getting lured away from his home by an enigmatic figure who throws him a lighter. Jimbob meets Nadine, a lump with a mouth, and helps her.
The protagonist escapes from a pool and runs away to the sea. A stop-motion animated film using unique materials such as slime and plasticised paper.
Ethel's childhood ends abruptly when her mother flies away, leaving Ethel alone to care for her younger siblings in their isolated homestead in Hairy Hill.
Based on the real-life account provided by a survivor of sexually motivated violent assault and her journey of recovery as she comes to terms with the trauma.
Through Robert Wyatt’s music, this animated musical plunges you into Bob and Alif’s passionate love story. They are two young artists immersed in the creative whirlwind of early 70s hippie culture.
O Nobly-Born, your breathing is about to cease. Listen with full attention, without being distracted. O Nobly-Born, go forward, you have been in a swoon.

Dans un monde désertique où les démons et les humains souffrent d'une pénurie d'eau extrême, le prince des démons Beelzebub, le démon Thief et le shérif humain Rao partent à l'aventure à la recherche de la Source légendaire, quelque part en plein milieu du désert.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Annecy Présente 2024) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: In Borneo, near the tropical forest, Kéria rescues a baby orangutang in the palm oil plantation where her father works. Kéria's cousin Selaï comes to live with them seeking refuge from the conflict between his indigenous tribe and the logging companies. Kéria, Selaï and the little orangutang, now named Oshi, will have to fight against their forest’s destruction.
The search for self, memories and emotions takes us through the forgotten, dark places of an inner world. We navigate 3D scans, torn between curiosity and resistance.
A full CGI commercial produced for Sharjah Book Authority for publishing to visualize how they might not write books, but they handle everything else that is book related.

About a pedantic animator that lives a routine life, only moving between home and work. Slowly sinking into apathy, she begins separating herself from the outside world. Her life turns upside down when she discovers a picture of sheep.
Two friends at a summer camp are surprised by a storm. To overcome their fear, they invent a world using their hands.
Paula the centaur-girl finds love, but now she must confront herself, her desires, the dilemmas of conformity and self-acceptance.
David Stora’s 1-minute take on Otto Preminger’s film.
A cosmic heroine in a sci-fi world, two unhappy people, and a fox. A few wild episodes depicting the frantic attempts to find meaning and the journey from the world of illusion to reality.
Regina, Norma and Isabel look into the mirror and begin the initiation ritual into magic. Make-up, glitter, and a blood pact create a new boldness in Regina, who is now ready for anything.

At the foot of a cliff in the middle of nowhere, two campers, intrigued by the noises outside, cross the deserted landscape, lamp in hand. This film was drawn and animated on one single sheet of paper as a performance.

In a farcical prehistory seemingly doomed never to evolve, a feuding father and daughter are about to shake up the Stone Age routine. After a tragicomic trip to the future and back, they accidentally bring back an Ikea "Allen key" that will finally trigger evolution, for better or worse.
The day-to-day lives and misadventures of a business dedicated to bringing happiness to its customers. A pair of employees, cynical Charlie and optimistic Pim, try to help out the troubled clients.
The origin story for one of Peanuts' most beloved characters, Franklin, follows how he approaches making new friends.

This is a movie about the beginning of life! A tale so basic and universal, it’s a wonder no one has told it before. We’re talking about the race, the origin of all races as it were, between millions of sperm cells, all frantically trying to fertilize a single egg. It’s a quest fraught with peril, where all but one are doomed to failure.
A VR documentary that takes viewers into the extraordinary journey of Dan Layani, a young soldier who tragically lost his sight in combat in 1982.

Can we say that we were sexually assaulted by our brother to our own mother? The obvious answer should be yes. However, few come out of the silence. The question we ask ourselves is "Why are't we talking about it?"

When shown a photograph of his six-year-old son, now digitally aged to fifty, Yathay's realities collide, igniting a painful journey into his mental prison of locked memories to unlock his redemption.
And if they also come for animators, will we speak up?
Taking its inspiration from a feminist sci-fi short story written in Bengal in 1905, Inés sets out on a voyage of discovery around India in search of Ladyland, the utopian land of women.
Lost in an endless desert, an injured teenager adopts the identity of a mythical unicorn to survive surreal encounters and rescue his father from the Cactus King.
Tabby McTat and his busker friend Fred are separated. Tabby McTat searches for Fred, but instead finds a new family. Can Tabby McTat and Fred finally reunite and rekindle their friendship?

films.t: TED-Ed "Does Planting Trees Actually Cool the Planet?"
films.syn: In fighting climate change, few solutions are discussed more than planting lots and lots of trees. Carolyn Beans explores strategies to successfully re-green the planet.

films.t: TED-Ed "How Did South African Apartheid Happen, and How Did It Finally End?"
films.syn: In this TED-Ed video, we visualized a period that ensured South Africa was dominated politically, socially and economically by the nation's elitist white population.

aw: Jury Award for a Commissioned Film

films.syn: A robotic vacuum cleaner suffering from burnout quits its job at a hospital and sets out to find a community and a greater purpose on a quiet street where two lonely rabbits are stuck in perpetual loops.
Through a series of leaps in time from the 1970s to a post-Anthropocene future, we follow in the footsteps of a mysterious creature.

More Gumball! The comedic misadventures of Gumball, Darwin and the quirky residents of Elmore continue in "The Amazing World of Gumball". Join Ben Bocquelet (Executive Producer), Matthew Layzell (Executive Producer), Emma Fernando (Series Producer), Xav Clarke (Composer), Sarah Fell (SVP, Series, Hanna-Barbera Studios Europe) for an inside look at the long-awaited return of these characters.

films.t: The Birth of Kitaro: The Mystery of GeGeGe
films.syn: Mizuki, a bank employee, goes to Nagura village on a secret mission. Gegero also goes to the village searching for his wife. In the Ryuga clan, who are secretly manipulating Japan, there is a struggle for the successor’s position. Suddenly, a clan member is murdered. This is the beginning of a horrifying chain of supernatural events.
Bubby introduces the alphabet until a sinister figure appears. Bubby must escape while trying to keep the alphabet lesson going.

films.t: The Car That Came Back from the Sea
films.syn: Full of exuberance and frivolousness, six friends drive to the Polish Baltic coast and back in a small, beaten-up car. During their trip, their car and their country fall apart. Nevertheless, life goes on.
A flat tire shocks a passenger. Stopped at the roadside, she thinks about her life while the driver changes the tire, unsure if this is the right path.

Synesthete Totsuko can see others as colors. Honor student Kimi has dropped out of school but still pretends to attend for her grandmother's sake. They reunite and decide to form a band with Rui, who dreams of composing on analog synthesizers but whose mother expects him to become a doctor. Together, they find freedom, joy, and love.

films.t: The Day the Earth Blew Up: A Looney Tunes Movie
films.syn: Porky Pig and Daffy Duck star as unlikely heroes and Earth's only hope when facing the threat of alien invasion. In this buddy-comedy of epic proportions, our heroes race to save the world, delivering all the laugh-out-loud gags and vibrant visuals that have made the Looney Tunes so iconic, but on a scope and scale yet to be experienced.

A weasel, who’s unusual job is to sell ties, roams around the countryside. Considered a pest and constantly on the move, she decides to try her luck in the forest. Her fate is about to change when a hedgehog intervenes.
This is an animated clash-of-cultures comedy TV series about an all-American family that relocates to Nigeria.

Garfield, le célèbre chat d'intérieur amateur de lasagnes qui déteste les lundis, est sur le point d'être embarqué dans une folle aventure ! Après avoir retrouvé son père disparu Vic, un chat des rues dépenaillé, Garfield et son ami le chien Odie sont forcés de quitter leur vie faite de confort pour aider Vic à accomplir un cambriolage aussi risqué qu'hilarant.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Annecy Présente 2024) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.ot: A Menina e o Pote (The Girl at the pot)
films.syn: In a dystopian world, a girl breaks her ceramic pot, which holds a secret inside, opening a portal to a parallel universe where the creation of a new world is finally possible.

A young, gifted Vincent and his father Tomas run the finest glass workshop in the country. They find their lives upended by an approaching war in which they want no part. The arrival of an army colonel and his young, aspiring violinist daughter Alliz, puts the father-son relationship to the test. As Vincent and Alliz fall in love, they must find courage to confront their fathers.
In reference to Dürer's "Great Piece of Turf", the film unites contradictions between analogue/digital, natural/artificial and attempts to create a physical experience of nature in a cinema space.

Rudger is a boy no one can see, imagined by Amanda to share her thrilling make-believe adventures. But when Rudger, suddenly alone, arrives at The Town of Imaginaries, where forgotten Imaginaries live and find work, he faces a mysterious threat.
A young child with a vivid imagination struggles to make sense of the world around him, he needs you – his imaginary friend – to help him navigate his feelings.
My 5-year journey from bereavement to the last goodbye, through an exploration of "existence" and "life", from different perspectives and stages of the mind.

films.t: The Lord of the Rings: The War of the Rohirrim
films.syn: Andy Serkis hosts a special presentation of "The Lord of the Rings: The War of the Rohirrim" featuring an extended look at the highly anticipated original anime feature alongside a filmmaker conversation with Oscar®-winner Philippa Boyens, award-winning Director Kenji Kamiyama, and Producers Joseph Chou and Jason DeMarco.

This fierce collaboration with ilovedust saw us merging cel animation and motion graphics, acting as a warning to humanity to stop drinking from plastic bottles or face the wrath of the Lords of Water.
The true story of Selinna Ajamikoko, a young Nigerian woman who dreams of becoming a meat seller like her mom. In order to achieve her dream, she begins her voyage to Italy.
When an alien comes back to take him, a mouthless young man's life twists and turns as his memories untangle.
In a cabin at a campsite deep in the forest, three girl scout children sit together and talk about scary stories, and encounter a small strange monster that comes into the cabin.

Once upon a time, in a vast wood, lived a poor woodcutter and a poor woodcutter’s wife. The cold, hunger, misery and war all around them make their life very harsh. One day, the poor woodcutter’s wife finds a baby thrown from one of the many trains that constantly pass through their wood. This baby, protected at all costs, this precious little cargo will disrupt the life of this woman, her husband’s, and all those who will cross its path, right up to the man who threw it off the train. Their story will bring out the worst and best in people’s hearts.

films.t: The Mouse Mansion, Sam & Julia "The Story with no End"
films.syn: After accidentally damaging the last pages of the book Sam has been passionately reading, Julia has to come up with some very inventive ways to improvise an original and visual ending to the interrupted story.
Animated on the pinscreen, this film revisits the tragic fate of Queen Mariana of Austria and her 1652 portrait by Velázquez.

Quand une violente tempête ravage leur maison, Laura, une paresseuse énergique, et sa famille excentrique trouvent refuge dans la grande ville. À bord de leur vieux foodtruck rouillé baptisé Gordito, ils espèrent faire de leur affaire un succès. Mais voilà, la délicieuse cuisine familiale attire la convoitise de Dotti Pace, une guéparde rusée prête à tout pour relancer son fast-food en péril.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Annecy Présente 2024) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: Torrential rain leads you into a colorful world of traditional Chinese ink art. A century-old sunken ship emerges, mysterious theater troupes come to life again. With countless masks worn by people and a world filled with intricate changes, what kind of bizarre story is unfolding?
A botanist returns to the past to study an extinct mushroom, but her machine takes her further than expected. Will she be able to return to the present day?
Orange is busy down on the farm, whilst on their way to feed their toy cow, penguin and crocodile, a carrot seems to have gone missing – Blue is sleeping on it!

The epic adventure follows the journey of a robot – ROZZUM unit 7134, "Roz" for short – that is shipwrecked on an uninhabited island and must learn to adapt to the harsh surroundings, gradually building relationships with the animals on the island and becoming the adoptive parent of an orphaned gosling.

Despite the world's disasters, an artist insists on playing. A story inspired by Bach's immortal music and painted onto toilet paper rolls as a tribute to the tradition of painting directly on 35mm film.

La jeune Natomi est soudain transportée d'un monde détruit par la guerre à un monde magique débordant de végétation. Guidée par un ours en peluche, elle doit découvrir les secrets de son père et échapper à la sinistre Reine qui la traque.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Annecy Présente 2024) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.t: This Is a Story Without a Plan
films.syn: Two people and an explosion.
A group of women witches struggle with the increasing violence in their town. Women are disappearing.
A violent stop-motion cabaret for the cynical and depraved. Guilt, alcoholic apathy and the inevitable, looming apocalypse threaten to push a young man to the brink.

films.t: Totto-Chan: The Little Girl at the Window
films.syn: At little Totto-Chan’s Tomoe School during the Second World War, she learns what racism and intolerance are, and discovers the grim reality of war.

Paramount Animation and Hasbro present, in association with New Republic Pictures: the first animated "Transformers" feature – a work-in-progress version – since the 1986 original. This movie takes place entirely on Cybertron and follows the origin story of how Optimus Prime and Megatron go from being brothers in arms to sworn enemies, ultimately leading to the centuries-long war between the Autobots and Decepticons.
For small children, the world is full of mystery and they need the help of an adult to navigate it. Or maybe it is the adults who, in the company of children, rediscover the magic in everyday life?

When Tokyo is threatened by rising monster attacks, an all-star athlete reluctantly returns home to take on the mantle of Ultraman, discovering that his greatest challenge isn’t fighting giant monsters: it’s raising one.

films.t: Un air de Glissant "Les yeux la voix"
films.syn: A project by Gilles Elie-Dit-Cosaque, this series of 10 short animation films is based on poetic texts by Edouard Glissant, directed by 10 different directors.
The last shovelful plunges the shot into darkness. The film seems to be talking about death, yet it's doing the exact opposite.
At a dinner party, an unexpected waltz unfolds, breaking free from the silent constraints of wage inequality and addressing unspoken issues.
In an era plagued by disinformation, a new superhero emerges to combat the global spread of "inFAKEtados". Meet Xika, an ordinary person with an extraordinary conviction.
Experimental animation. Light and sound. Made in Ireland.
A series of short content designed for social channels, each film follows creatures taking a stand against the destruction of their habitat whilst encouraging viewers to support RSPB's conservation.
A gardener tends a small garden in a field overgrown with weeds. What begins as an innocent encounter turns into a fight for survival and an attempt to preserve the existing world at any cost.

films.t: When It Comes (It Will Have Your Eyes)
films.ot: Etorriko da (eta zure begiak izango ditu)
films.syn: A small community enters a state of collapse due to an environmental crisis and is adapting as best it can to the new reality. The privileged residents live a hedonistic life based on carpe diem, while the others struggle to survive with no alternative.

In a zombie-infested Japan, Rika, an infected intern, cares for genius Rei and sister Yuna. Yuna turns zombie: Rika and Rei flee. Rika suggests escaping abroad with Takashiba in search of hope, Rei wants to return home. At Rei's, they face a transformed Yuna's confession. Amid despair, is hope alive?
A movie about a breakup. The narrative develops through the author's conversations with his long-time partner, and follows the contemplation of the end of a nine-year romantic relationship.
An uptight engineer gets an unwelcome visit from an enthusiastic wannabe-pilot, causing both of them to be launched into the air inside an out-of-control space shuttle.
Ahmad Joudeh was a stateless refugee, until dancing changed his life. This film was commissioned by the World Economic Forum for World Refugee Day. Design-oriented animation in Ahmad's own voice.

Amazed by the world around her, Lisa loves to collect all sorts of things. On a day at the beach, she's excited to start a seashell collection, but her plans change when she meets a hermit crab in need.
Using real smoke to tell the poignant story of a young girl in a smoke-filled world symbolizing the grave consequences of environmental neglect.
A strange interaction between a wandering man and a mysterious creature, Yapolaponky.

films.t: You Are the Truck and I Am the Deer
films.syn: Relating to a feeling, a feeling of roaming, gnawing hunger. The knife's edge between corruption and rebirth: the potential for total destruction.
Yuck! Kissing on the mouth is disgusting. But secretly, little Léo really wants to try it.

films.t: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead "Akira of the Dead"
films.syn: The entire city is being ravaged by the undead, but Akira has never felt more alive! That's why he is on a mission to complete all 100 items on his bucket list.

The ocean is paradise for Fran the shrimp. Her deadly claws take whatever they desire. For the blind fish Milva, it’s a daily fight to survive. Fran sees her as beautiful and wants her to see the ocean in the same way. Can they overcome their differences?

films.t: A Bird Hit My Window and Now I'm a Lesbian
films.syn: After a mysterious girl shows up at Gray's doorstep holding the corpse of a bird that had just cracked her window, an impromptu bird funeral changes the way Gray views herself and her lesbian identity.

films.t: A Legendary Encounter: Icons of Animation Celebrate "The Simpsons"
films.syn: Le Festival international du film d’animation d’Annecy est fier accueillir Matt Groening, créateur visionnaire des Simpson , ainsi que le producteur exécutif et showrunner visionnaire Matt Selman et la légende de l’animation David Silverman. Le 10 juin, ils monteront sur scène pour une table ronde exclusive, offrant un rare aperçu de l’héritage révolutionnaire de la série dans le domaine de l’animation. Groening sera honoré par un prix spécial pour sa contribution inégalée à cet art.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Séances événements 2025) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: At the height of his fame, Marcel Pagnol is commissioned to write a literary serial about his childhood and Provence. As he writes the first pages, the little Marcel as he was as a child suddenly appears in front of him triggering his memories: the advent of talking pictures, the first major film studio, his love of actors, and writing. The great storyteller then becomes the hero of his own story.
A small cat journeys into the garden of the afterlife in search of a magical flower.

Iconic Marvel characters like Gwenpool, War Machine, and Emma Frost battle for control of Pandora’s Box on Fortnite Island. With bold comic book-inspired art and the intense track by MF DOOM, this trailer delivers an epic collision of worlds.
An old Beirut resident checks the obituaries page and attends funerals daily. His "mourning" routine reveals a journey of grieving and accepting the loss of a loved one, a home and a city.

Chiba Prefecture, Japan. The Boso Peninsula. A massive, unidentified plant from outer space, known as "Darol", has spread its roots across the land, wreaking havoc with its electromagnetic waves and high-concentration gas, devastating the environment on a massive scale. To aid in the recovery efforts, volunteers from across the country and abroad have been randomly selected.

Birahima, a ten-year-old orphan from Guinea, tells with irony how he is thrown into tribal warfare while trying to reach his aunt in Liberia. Yacouba, a shady man, convinces him to become a child soldier, while he becomes a grigriman and witch doctor among the fighters. Shunted between enemy factions, Birahima grows up quickly and learns to distrust the stories that he's told.
After another night of insomnia, a man comes across a strange community living in his building and discovers the elaborate illusion they have created.

Moon, a curious young owl, unexpectedly finds himself stuck in a Christmas tree destined for Rockefeller Plaza. In his attempts to escape the bustling city, Moon befriends a lost little girl named Luna.

aw: Jury Award for a TV Special

films.syn: Lorsqu'un groupe d'animaux de la ferme se rebelle et chasse leur fermier de ses terres, la vie devient belle et le rêve de la liberté est réalisé. Mais des luttes de pouvoir se présentent entre certains des personnages les plus célèbres de la littérature, et les réalités d’un monde créé pour les humains complexifient et corrompent la satirique, Animal Farm.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Séances événements 2025) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: A trailer for the 21 st edition of the Animateka International Animation Film Festival, showcasing children's, educational and family programmes. Let's dive into the animated imagination together!

11-year-old orphan Anne is mistakenly adopted by Marilla and Matthew who live in Avonlea, on picturesque Prince Edward Island in Canada. Despite the difficulties of her past, she maintains an imaginative mind and pure heart.

After death, before reincarnation, the souls of the deceased transit through a fantastical realm known as, Another World. Gudo is a spirit that helps to guide these transient souls to their reincarnation. While guiding a young girl named Yuri, he learns that humans have emotions that he does not understand. Tasked by Goddess Mira to help Yuri control her rage and prevent her transformation into a monster, Gudo embarks on a perilous mission.

Anselmo dreams about a variety of jobs every time he is asked about his future. Between failures, unexpected successes and his rivalry with Letizia, he will show us how every job, if done with passion and dedication, can be the greatest job ever!
A seemingly harmless prank turns into a delirious nightmare revolving around spiders.

Imagine if rainbows were actually time travellers? 10-year-old Arco lives in the distant future. During his first flight in his rainbow suit, he goes off course, loses control, and lands in our near future. Iris, a little girl who’s the same age as Arco, sees him fall from the sky. She will do everything she possibly can to help him go back home.
A young man and three women are winter-bound in a large country mansion. A new arrival in the house will gradually change the young man’s attitude about both his own and their desire.

films.t: Astérix & Obélix, le Combat des chefs "Épisode 102"
films.syn: In Gaul tradition, if one Gaul chieftain loses in hand-to-hand combat to another, the vanquished leader and his people become the subjects of the victor. The Romans kidnap Panoramix out on a lone walk, and a botched attempt to save him from capture causes him to lose his memory.
In the midst of war, a man watches his beloved one by lighting the three matches he has left. Then, in the pitch darkness, a forest grows from their lovemaking and protects them from the war.

For Hugo, visiting Chernobyl’s forbidden area is not a commemorative trip. If this young tourist wanders through radioactive ruins, it is mainly to feed his Instagram account. This absurd quest will lead him to discover a population he never knew existed.

films.t: Baby Bot's Backyard Tales S.1 E.4 "Where's Billy?"
films.syn: Everyone is ready for Halloween, except Billy, who's missing! In this spooky episode, Baby Bot and friends search for him and learn about the importance of embracing their differences.

In Sardinia in 1940, in early WWII, horses are stolen from a military farm. The protagonists are two boys, Ventura and Michele, aged 11 and 14 with idealistic intentions: free the horses so they do not die in war. They succeed, but on their way back they are intercepted by the rural militia and one of them is killed. Michele's sister, Anna, Ventura’s close friend, must identify his body.

An exploration into the phenomenon of bodybuilding as it examines the relationship fitness-oriented men have with their own bodies. The stories of three men who use exercise as a way to cope with inner traumas that have often resulted in low self-esteem.
Clément receives a telephone call from Tessa. It’s been a long time since they last spoke. As night falls, he gets lost in the city.

After crash-landing on planet Proxima astronaut Cosima meets her larger-than-life BFF Big Lizard! Together they have a whole prehistoric world to explore and fun to be had, guided by Cosima's Dad and on-board supercomputer D.O.R.I.S.
Blargh is a passive little feller. Everything just kind of happens around him, while he’s keeping it all in. So much that he discovers a ball of black goo in his stomach.

An exploration into the insatiable greed of the African leader and the cost of betrayal. Against a backdrop of neocolonialism, we see the illusion of power, corruption that festers behind closed doors, and the silent suffering of a people forgotten by those meant to lead them.
When filmmaker Megan Wennberg's period went nuts, she thought her Uterus was out for revenge because she was almost 40 and hadn't given it a baby. But it turned out she had fibroids.
Under the rules, we are in a box, and within the box is one game after another. This movie uses the game as a metaphorical vehicle to explore the conflict between social discipline and self-will.
A devoted sister flees with her brother, a benevolent, bread-turned zombie. A mob pursues, mouths agape. Streets twist into mazes, reason dissolves, hunger reigns. Can love defy appetite?

Brown animals gradually invade and take over households, from petty compromises to outright cowardice. An authoritarian power with preposterous laws is being introduced. To stay out of trouble, Charly bows to the rules of this colourless world and discovers the horror of fascism.
When the electricity came, Majid fell in love with her. However, this was neither the time nor the place for such love!
A tiny bird restores the pianist's final hope by revealing the music hidden in everyday moments.

films.t: Captain Sabertooth and the Countess of Grel
films.syn: Raven et Pinky, meilleurs amis, servent à bord du navire du redouté Capitaine Sabertooth, roi des Sept Mers. Lorsque la rusée comtesse Sibylla de Grel attaque leur bateau, elle vole une figure de proue légendaire et enlève Pinky. Ce n’est que le début de son plan machiavélique pour piéger Sabertooth et s’emparer du royaume des pirates. Le jeune matelot Raven, le capitaine Sabertooth, un dragon et un cuisinier excentrique doivent arrêter la comtesse et sauver Pinky.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Annecy Présente 2025) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: Hunting season has begun. A family of capybaras seeks refuge in a chicken coop, but the hens don't trust them. The curiosity of the youngest members of the families will create a union with unexpected consequences.
As flight 7836 reaches cruising speed above the Atlantic Ocean, the pilot, co-pilot and flight attendant are startled by an unexpected knock at the door! Should they open the door, or not?

When an overwhelmed, single dad pig moves his piglets into a rundown trailer park, he fears he’s failed his family. But soon his kids create a wildly imaginative game from a simple cardboard box, and Dad must make a choice…

Looking for sex or romance? Two strangers wake up together in a sunny bed. They're young, queer and share the sweet thrill of peeking into each other's most intimate life. They have nothing to lose, so why is it hard to talk about sexual desires and romantic dreams?
In the apartment, confusion sets in. The question is, how do you live there again?

In a future society where humans and mermaids coexist, Stephan, a regular office worker at a shipbuilding company, is suddenly proposed to by Chao – a princess from the mermaid kingdom! With no time to make sense of what's happening, Stephan finds himself living together with Chao. As he is showered with Chao's pure and wholehearted love, Stephan gradually begins to fall for her. What will become of their unlikely romance?

films.t: Chickenhare and the Secret of the Groundhog
films.syn: Ayant fait de sa différence une force, Hopper explore le monde avec Meg, moufette experte en arts martiaux, et Archie, tortue sarcastique. Lorsqu’il découvre Gina, sa sœur, tout bascule : il n’est pas seul. Tiraillé entre loyauté et devoir, Hopper part en quête d’un pouvoir légendaire pour sauver les siens. Une aventure périlleuse à travers des mondes saisissants, où secrets et dilemmes s’entremêlent.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Annecy Présente 2025) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: Christo, a Civilized Barbarian, consistently tries and fails to bring Roman-esque decency, decorum, and cleanliness to his dim-witted yet affable brethren.
A swooping fly starts a line of events that leads us all the way to WWI.

The diary account of an office worker’s day. A humorous view of his casual homosexual adventures turns bitter when the viewer realizes that he already has a relationship with a deeply depressed, alcoholic man.
In a private karaoke booth, I encounter a being on the TV screen. I am envious of this being on the screen, then I get lost in my imagination. What is this being?

An office worker unravels as he struggles to deal with bullying, psychological violence and harassment at work. At work, psychological health can sometimes be so fragile that it "hangs by a thread." The campaign aims to spark open conversations and encourage proactive solutions.
A girl wakes up alone in the dark, surreal night, triggering fragmented memories of the neglect by her caregivers.
Organic shapes are drifting, changing and constantly making new forms.

We follow former high school lab mates Marshall and Frances as they unravel a conspiracy involving big pharma and the government to suppress knowledge of a rare fungus secret that may contain the solution to cure all world's diseases.

When Mika sits on the toilet, she is shocked to discover that there is something slimy and "cottage-cheese-like" in her underwear. In search of answers, she then embarks on a bizarre journey into her own vagina.

films.t: Creating Creativity: Celebrating 25 Years of Cartoon Network Studios
films.syn: Un événement spécial en hommage au studio qui a défié les normes de l’industrie et marqué une génération de fans. Rejoignez des créateurs visionnaires – Genndy Tartakovsky ( Le Laboratoire de Dexter ), Craig McCracken ( Les Supers Nanas ), Pendleton Ward ( Adventure Time ), Rebecca Sugar ( Steven Universe ), J.G. Quintel ( Regular Show ), Adam Muto ( Adventure Time: Fionna & Cake ) – pour une discussion sur l’histoire, l’avenir et l’héritage durable de Cartoon Network Studios.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Séances événements 2025) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: 11-year-old Iris lives with her grandmother and her cat Cristal. One night, while the grandmother and Iris are sleeping, Death arrives unexpectedly to take the grandmother's soul but accidentally extracts the girl's soul. Cristal tries to stop Death.

Un jeune prince entreprend un voyage magique à la recherche du bonheur, rencontre des fées, des sorcières et des diables malicieux dans un monde de conte de fées vibrant et enchanteur où l'amour et le courage sont mis à l'épreuve.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Annecy Présente 2025) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: Dendelion, Baraban, Léonto and Taraxa, four dandelion achenes rescued from a succession of nuclear explosions destroying the Earth, find themselves hurled into the cosmos, stranded on an unknown planet, in search of a soil suitable for the survival of their species. But the elements, fauna, flora and climate are just some of the obstacles they must overcome.

A young couple seem to have a peaceful life, but the woman suffers a one-sided emotional relationship. The man has sex with her and treats her like a servant, yet he believes that he is a feminist and a defender of women’s rights.

After a botched armed attack where Hélène ditches her comrades, Manon, one of her accomplices in the attack, comes back to haunt her. Together, they travel through a magical valley, where metamorphoses, poisonous powers and dramatic events will soon upset the natural balance. Hélène will have to take another look at her choices, both intimate and political, and the dilemmas that define them.

A father leaves his young daughter behind in pursuit of his "dream," and she grows up alone amidst adversity. After years of separation, an unexpected reunion forces her to confront the all-too-familiar stranger that is her father.

The film explores the deep connection between Deccani wool, the land and its people, highlighting its cultural, spiritual, and ecological significance. It delves into the resilience of the Deccani sheep, the traditions of shepherding, and the sacred role of wool in daily life.

aw: Jury Award for a Commissioned Film

films.syn: Detlev, who is constantly cold, drives to an isolated petrol station every evening to order a microwaved Hawaii Toast. His bizarre daily ritual is the only thing that warms him up, but observed by a stranger one night, his world crumbles into shameful pieces.
Sinister forces are at play to open the portal between the human and demon realms. Dante, an orphaned demon-hunter-for-hire, is unaware that the fate of both worlds hangs around his neck.
After witnessing his parents' violent fight, eleven-year-old Berci struggles with his anger and emotions, finding a way to release them through his interactions with his dog.

A group of neighbours, each focused on their own goals, must learn to communicate and consider one another. But when small, everyday actions trigger unexpected consequences, they are forced into interactions that challenge their independence.

Inspired by an anecdote from booming Tokyo in the 1980s, the film tells the glamorous story of the real estate shark Akio Kashiwagi. Akio's great passion is illegal gambling in the underworld. An American is on his trail and tries to track down stolen money.

The film examines the divine female figure in West African sculpture through an exploration of the director/animator’s Bété ancestry, drawing upon the spiritual iconography of the Bété people and other tribal groups on the Ivory Coast.

A family portrait that uses imagination, humor and storytelling to explore the contrasting upbringings between two half-brothers, one white and one Indigenous, held together by a lively cast of characters.
This animated trilogy puts Enedis technicians in the spotlight, observed by some curious birds. Amusing bystanders, these birds add a touch of humour.

Des animaux de compagnie, piégés dans un train lancé à toute allure, vont devoir déjouer les plans de Hans, un blaireau rancunier en quête de vengeance. Alors que le crash semble inévitable, les animaux peuvent compter sur Falcon, un raton-laveur filou et débrouillard, prêt à tout pour les sauver !

ap.sel: Officially selected (Séances événements 2025) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: In a God-fearing village, giving birth to a "fačuk", an illegitimate child, is a mortal sin. In this narrow-minded, harsh, rural environment, fear grows inside the young pregnant woman who is about to give birth at any moment.

A pre-apocalyptic midnight walk takes you through a burning forest to witness a looming destruction. A fire in the forest either marks an impending doom or serves as a metaphysical gateway between realities.

In Japan, 1975, Junko is preparing to be the first woman to reach the top of Mount Everest. But when she is rejected from professional mountaineering clubs, she must train her own group of amateurs to do the trip with her. Will they make it?

Bull, un chien ordinaire mais sympa, découvre qu'il va être castré le lendemain matin ! Alors que la gravité de cet événement qui va changer sa vie se fait sentir, Bull réalise qu'il a besoin d'une dernière aventure avec sa meute de meilleurs amis, car ce sont les dernières 24 heures avec ses testicules ! Qu'est-ce qui pourrait mal tourner... ?

ap.sel: Officially selected (Séances événements 2025) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: After a near-death experience, a person floats in a mysterious space, gradually being reborn by reconnecting with the sensations of their body.

Lorsque Thomas rencontre Fleak, une créature poilue venue d’une autre dimension, il se retrouve embarqué dans une aventure fantastique au cours de laquelle il découvre un moyen de remarcher. Mais en échange, il doit affronter un monstre dévoreur de tout, né de sa propre ombre.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Annecy Présente 2025) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: A daughter gradually realizes that her father suffers from a mental illness. Isolated and rejected by society, he lives alone in a dark apartment, drifting like a balloon. She searches for a way to reconnect and bring him back down to earth.

Football is a very masculine sport, where players fight body to body to gain control of the ball. During a match, love can blossom between players and taboos can be broken in this king of all ball sports.
An orphaned bear cub finds a home with a fatherly evergreen tree, until his hunger for trash leads him to danger.

What would you do when your home appears to be in danger? Would you stay or leave? Each day, since the beginning of the war, millions of Ukrainians ask themselves this question. This immersive experience poses this question to each of us.

aw: Cristal for the Best VR Work

films.syn: Théo would like to ask Auriane to move in with him. So, Anxiety organizes a crisis meeting.
Investigating interplay between sound and picture. Experimental animation experience produced by drawing both sound and picture onto 35mm film.

An ecstatic biopic about the world's most successful living painter. In vivid images, this AI hybrid film sheds light on the social role of painting in the tension between creativity, capital investment, and spirituality.

A mighty thunder god’s powers grew so immense that the other gods trembled in fear. So, they decided to seal his powers, dividing them into six pieces, each guarded by a different god. Can the thunder god reclaim his lost powers and subdue the gods who betrayed him?

Will, une petite chèvre qui obtient une chance unique de rejoindre les pros et de jouer au roarball, un sport très intense, mixte et brutal, dominé par les animaux les plus rapides et les plus féroces. Les nouveaux coéquipiers de Will ne sont pas enthousiastes à l'idée d'avoir une petite chèvre dans leur équipe, mais Will est déterminé à prouver que même les petits peuvent faire sensation en compétition.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Séances événements 2025) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.t: Goat Girl "I ain’t afraid of no goat"
films.syn: Goat Girl is a quirky coming-of-age comedy about Gigi, a pre-teen raised by goats, facing her biggest challenge: school! She must interact with actual people and make friends. In this episode, Gigi, Saige, and Sully hunt for Goodenough's legendary ghost to see if it's real.

In 1806, the collapse of Mount Rossberg triggered one of Switzerland's most devastating natural disasters, which obliterated the village of Goldau, claiming 457 lives. This film vividly portrays the harrowing moments that reshaped an entire valley.

films.t: Guard Dog & Bill Plympton in Brazil "Lost in Iguazu"
films.ot: Guard Dog & Bill Plympton no Brasil "Lost in Iguazu"
films.syn: Guard Dog, Bill Plympton's most famous creation, travels through Brazil, seeing danger at every single one of the country's traditions and landmarks and leaving behind a path of chaos as he tries to find his beloved human owner.
All about a 13-year-old girl’s small yet life-changing act of rebellion on the road to womanhood and feminism. It captures the universality of girls exploring gender, curiosity and freedom.

Most people will encounter their second "weaning" in life. We often take for granted that the relationships between people are unbreakable. But when we lose connection with the outside world, how do we face ourselves? How do we find meaning in solitude?

In a rundown office, a group of people are stuck to the ceiling by their hats. When an old telephone rings the office workers start disappearing one by one. Hatker realizes that something strange is happening and tries to free himself, turning his world upside down.

Rio de Janeiro in the near future. Marlow is a police officer assigned to a mission to find Captain Kurtz, a famous policeman who went missing in mysterious circumstances. Marlow must do his mission in a boat, setting out on a dangerous journey through the outskirts of Rio de Janeiro.
An elderly man wants to report his wife's disappearance.

In a post-apocalyptic world, a famished man encounters an abandoned house containing a bountiful feast. Despite mounting suspicion and unease, he continues to consume the enigmatic food. His fears are confirmed when he hears a noise and investigates.
C'est l'histoire d'un adolescent passionné qui déclenche une rébellion pour libérer l'expression et la musique dans sa ville.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Séances événements 2025) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: Sur l’île de Beurk, où Vikings et dragons se livrent une guerre sans merci, le jeune Harold bouleverse les traditions en se liant d’amitié avec Krokmou, un redoutable Furie nocturne. Mais lorsqu’une ancienne menace refait surface, leur lien inattendu pourrait bien devenir la clé d’un monde nouveau.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Séances événements 2025) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: Son of a glove puppetry master, Xiao Guo, after his parents' divorce, could only accompany his father backstage at outdoor performances, often lacking stable meals and motherly care! At one performance, the puppet beside him comes to life and tries to take on the role of his mother...
Today, Lea goes in search of a subject for a documentary film. When she believes she's finally caught her prey, the roles end up being reversed. The hunter becomes the hunted.

Togashi est né pour courir. Dès son plus jeune âge, il est naturellement doué et remporte sans effort toutes les courses de 100 mètres. Mais en sixième, il rencontre Komiya, un élève transféré, plein de détermination mais qui manque de technique. En lui enseignant, Togashi donne à Komiya un nouveau but : gagner quoi qu'il en coûte. Les années passent, Togashi et Komiya se retrouvent à nouveau, cette fois en tant que rivaux sur la piste, et cela révélera leurs véritables personnalités.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Annecy Présente 2025) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: In early April 1994, Valentine and Jean-Claude start a new life in Kigali with their newborn baby, Justice. Their country, already battered by racial propaganda and brutality, finally seems ready for peace and justice.
Following a breakup, a man who hasn't seen his son in months writes a song.

The story of a puppet, from his "birth" to the uncertain decision to follow the example of his father/creator, through discovering a humanity that frightens him, and of which he will have to become a part.

Throughout There once is, we encounter a little sunhat bolo boy, a bluebeard man, a wolf on a motorcycle, a duck that lays golden eggs, three little pigs, and many more characters whom we think we know already, but turn out to be different than expected. Seeing as these tales cross both centuries and horizons, this series is an opportunity for a colourful present-day voyage. So fasten your seatbelts, we are ready for take-off!
This is a revolutionary and fun mixed reality experience, which aims to show the world how it is perceived by people with ADHD.

films.t: In Search of the Star Vegetable – Episode 2 : "Boris and His Drum"
films.ot: À la recherche du légume star – Épisode 2 : "Boris et son tambour"
films.syn: Vegetables come to life and take the stage in a competition hosted by Toma Théo. Each vegetable wants to be the kids’ favourite! Learn all about the benefits of vegetables, including African ones, and some easy Madagascan recipes.

A divine young man, Jin Feng, descends to the mortal world to redeem his mother by capturing the 28 star spirits. He crosses paths with Fanning, a mortal girl seeking to ascend to the divine world to find her mother. Though they start off as rivals, they eventually team up to complete their mission, only to uncover a long-hidden mysterious truth.

Interior and exterior, transparency and opacity, exhibitionism and voyeurism, feminine and masculine: all these notions oppose or unite in the infinite cycle of a labyrinth with no exit. Life here is like a loom whose living weft is woven from a myriad of branching threads and paths.

Jack, a former lighthouse keeper in his prime, lives a peaceful existence isolated on his cliff-island lost in the middle of the ocean. He encounters a great white pelican stranded on his island. A story of friendship that will change Jack's life.

Despite his hellish prison cell and the constant suffering, Felix the good giant always seeks the bright side of life. His bullet-proof serenity infuriates the vicious Chief Warden who has sworn to uncover the inmate's secret and eradicate his happiness once and for all. A fantasy tale about the price of freedom.

films.t: Jeremy Super Caribou "Jeremy's Fast Delivery Service"
films.syn: At the grocery store, Roslyn the poodle provides a home food delivery service. She hires Bernard the clumsy squirrel and Ronnie the crazy rabbit as delivery drivers. However, accidents increase on the valley roads. Thank goodness, Jeremy is here!

From birth to death, each person goes through life with a variety of nicknames, and sometimes derogatory. The story depicts the beautiful yet sorrowful life of the protagonist who, unintentionally, rises to the top, against a backdrop of problems we are facing today, such as elderly drivers, the dark side of the entertainment industry, the unknown deaths of young people, and war.
The coming-of-age story of Óscar, a young boy who doesn't want to stop playing his childhood games in a world that is forcing him to grow as war grips his hometown.
Kiff discovers a hidden talent and finds out she is good at sports.

Tipptopp, the little chestnut girl, travels on a leaf high in the air. She falls into an unfamiliar forest. The autumn nights are turning cold already, yet no matter how hard Tipptopp tries, she cannot find shelter among the animals. Then, she meets Kippkopp.

Accused by the authorities of not working hard enough, Vladimir is forced to live with an idiot as punishment. He chooses him from an asylum and his name is Vova. This idiot can only pronounce one syllable: ooh.
The German saying, "Don´t paint the devil on the wall", is portrayed by combining wall paintings and digital paintings, exploring the impact of human sensory loss.

Lorsque Lucie, 9 ans, arrive à Bectoile pour les vacances, elle n'a aucune idée des aventures qui l'attendent. Sa mère, Caro, mène des fouilles archéologiques dans la région avec son collègue Pierrot. La campagne de Bectoile, c'est aussi là où a grandi Caro, et le théâtre d'un secret de famille… que Lucie s'apprête à dévoiler ! Avec l'aide d'un couple de mésanges très spécial et de son nouvel ami Yann, Lucie est bien décidée à se plonger dans son histoire familiale. Des sous-sols d'un château en ruine à une vieille caravane oubliée à l'orée des bois, cette aventure les mènera de surprises insolites en fabuleuses découvertes !

ap.sel: Officially selected (Séances événements 2025) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: The squirrel's nest is warmly padded out for the cold winter with all kinds of stolen goods. But a sudden flood forces all the forest animals to flee to Lena's farm. The squirrel would like to help them...

aw: Jury Award for a TV Series

films.syn: A mysterious rabbit with a set of magic keys summons a host of strange creatures to entertain a wicked king and his decadent court in this dark fantasy inspired by the works of Ladislas Starevich.
A space princess is thrust out of her sheltered life and onto a galactic quest to save her bounty hunter ex-girlfriend from the Straight White Maliens.

Golnaz, a 23-year-old Iranian immigrant girl, tries to cope with her new life in Germany. Cooking some rice with saffron, a childhood dish, her traumatic memories resurface: three years earlier, she survived when the boat sank, but her whole family drowned.

You enter a calm yet unfamiliar world, lying dormant when you arrive. As you explore its surroundings, the world gradually opens up, revealing its light. The more you engage with it, the more you become enveloped in a soothing yet lively awakening, full of surprises.

Utopian symbolic playgrounds from childhood memories are interconnected through sharp, flickering lights. This is a poetic documentary that explores the ambivalence of memory through the real locations on the outskirts of Tbilisi.

films.t: Little Amélie or the Character of Rain
films.ot: Amélie et la Métaphysique des tubes
films.syn: Until the age of two and a half years old, Amélie describes herself as a digestive tube, inert and vegetative. Then comes the crucial event that makes her leap into childhood. She discovers language, parents, brothers and sisters, a heavenly garden, passions (Japan and water), aversions (to carp), seasons and time. Everything that, from the age of three, constitutes the human person forever. Because at that age, everything is played out, happiness as well as tragedy.
He observes. She plays. Forgotten love lingers. The Moon is just a pale witness to it all. Still pale.

Early 20 th century in Buenos Aires. Malevo and his girlfriend María, attend a quilombo in a tough city area and meet Cepeda, a hypnotic violinist who seduces María. Drunken Malevo seeks revenge, but at the peak of his rage, unexpected revelations come to light.

En 1811, Mary Anning, une jeune fille de 12 ans curieuse et déterminée, passe ses journées à chercher des fossiles. Son père lui a transmis cette passion, mais sa vie bascule lorsqu’il disparaît, laissant un mystérieux dessin et une famille en difficulté. Résolue à aider sa mère et son frère, Mary tente de percer le secret du dessin. Elle découvrira bien plus que des fossiles : amitiés, aventures et les débuts de la paléontologie.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Annecy Présente 2025) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: A determined 10-year-old girl named Max, pursues her dream of becoming a knight by leading her friends on an epic adventure in the fantastical medieval kingdom of Byjovia. Max will defy the status quo, fight for justice, and inspire everyone she meets.

Maya et son papa vivent dans deux pays différents. Pour maintenir le lien avec sa fille et continuer à lui raconter des histoires, son papa lui demande chaque mois " Maya, donne moi un titre ". À partir de ce titre, il lui fabrique un dessin animé dont elle est l’héroïne. Michel Gondry donne alors vie à un voyage poétique et amusant qui fera rêver les petits...et sourire les grands.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Séances événements 2025) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: One day, my appearance suddenly changes into something strange. I repeatedly peel off my skin and attempt to return to my original form.

At the heart of a magical forest, its inhabitants are waiting for a giant shell to reveal a theatre. The curtains swing open to unveil a dancer and her little helpers who assist her in transforming into a butterfly woman.

While fleeing from the Russians, little Sophie and her parents meet the Nazi Scharf and the Hitler Youth Beckmann in a hotel. In the fight with Scharf, Sophie loses her parents and her memory. The Russians occupy the hotel, find Sophie and make her a cook. Sophie finds Beckmann, remembers him and leaves the hotel.

In a world where humans coexist with androids called Neans, a group known as the Immortal Nine rises up against society. A Nean named Rouge Redstar and investigator Naomi Orthmann head to Mars to track them down…but first, Rouge wants some chocolate.

Universal Century 0096. Three years after the last conflict between Neo Zeon and the Earth Federation, an independent mercenary organization is hired by the Earth Federation to track down a former Commander who joined Neo Zeon remnants "Sleeves". An all-new and epic adventure into the heart of one of Japan's most iconic anime universes.

films.t: Mononoke The Movie: Chapter II – The Ashes of Rage
films.syn: Shortly after the frenzied battle against the mononoke, Karakasa, the Medicine Seller returns to Ōoku. There, the aftermath of the previous incident has left its mark, causing a shift in the power dynamics inside the inner chambers. In his pursuit to defeat the mononoke, Medicine Seller delves deeper into the darkness that lurks within Ōoku, seeking to uncover the threefold truth of form, truth, and reason to confront the mononoke and resolve the crisis.

In a society made of clay, devoted to worshipping a Hand statue as their God, a temple servant discovers a severed finger and learns their deity is dead. Chaos ensues, and society turns its devotion to the finger, raising questions on the nature of belief and the human need for worship.

Mary is a mother and caregiver for her mentally and physically disabled son. This means giving care around the clock and so much red tape that a surreal situation is looming. How does Mary keep her head above water?

Imagine a bright red mouth opening wide, propelling us into a vortex of colors and nature. Strange fragments of bodies—whether allies or enemies—join the ride. Luckily, the mouth has wings… and a car! Between dreamscapes, feminism, and pop music, welcome to the universe of Sol Rosa.

Piet, an elderly man in a nursing home, finds himself limited in his actions when he suddenly begins to transform into a bird. Although he is still accepted within the group, he feels that it's time to join a new flock.

aw: Jean-Luc Xiberras Award for a First Film

films.syn: One day, Ben meets his algorithm, a giant neon cat. A golden prison that reinforces his beliefs, alienates and comforts him. This is a contemporary fable in the form of a psychedelic odyssey into the virtual space of social networks.

The complexities of a past shared by identical twins Omar and Wesam. A split narrative retells both sides of their memories – from the instant they were fused together in their mother’s womb to the moment they are parted when one of them tragically dies.
Leaving everything to fate is liberating. It relieves us of all responsibility and makes it possible to enjoy the present. Fate, however, always has an ace up its sleeve.

Noboru est un garçon de 10 ans en quête de son identité culturelle. Il demande à son grand-père Hideo de lui parler de sa famille. Malgré avoir toujours fui son passé, Hideo accepte de raconter son histoire. En explorant l'histoire familiale, Noboru découvre l’existence d’un oncle dont il n'avait jamais entendu parler.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Annecy Présente 2025) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: Grace Lee, an overworked mom in Singapore, collapses at work. She gets admitted into hospital, where she finds newfound freedom as a patient.

films.t: Naive New Beaters, Star Feminine Band "Ye Kou Si Kuo"
films.syn: After a wild party in their flat, three hungover friends get ready for the next one, while jamming to their favorite band.

Oasis is celebrating manga culture with an animated film inspired by the openings, taking the audience into an epic adventure alongside the Oasis mascots. This project pays tribute to the aesthetic and narrative codes of anime, captivating manga fans.

A snoozing fisherman, a dozing gardener, a restful raver... A diverse collection of characters falls asleep whilst listening to "The Sleeping Forecast" in this hand-crafted stop-motion spot for the BBC Sounds podcast.
A girl longs to hit puberty and get big boobs, only to end up growing tiny ones. Confronting the judgment of others and herself, she struggles to accept her chest size.

films.t: Next on Netflix Animation: From "Stranger Things: Tales From '85" to "In Your Dreams"
films.syn: Le showrunner Eric Robles, nous révèlera en avant première mondiale, les toutes premières images de la série Stranger Things à venir. Le réalisateur Alex Woo, le directeur artistique Steven Pilcher, et le superviseur des effets visuels Nicola Lavender, présenteront également pour la première fois des extraits de leur prochain film Dans tes rêves , dans le cadre d’une table ronde.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Séances événements 2025) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: College student Rin and high-school student Tamahi investigate the secrets hidden in a vintage apartment building that has been the subject of rumors of psychic phenomena and strange deaths.

The film tells the story of Curt Unckel, a social scientist who lived with indigenous peoples for 40 years. Curt was baptized in 1906 by the Guarani as Nimuendajú and dedicated his life to studying and understanding different cultures. He witnessed the persecution and expulsion of indigenous peoples from their lands.

A pair of Yetis wants to bring holiday cheer to a local village, but they inadvertently scare everyone away. A clever little girl recognizes their true intentions and gathers her people to toast their new furry friends.
A surreal exploration on love’s complexities. Following the stories of Olivia, Ramón, Bárbara and Mauricio, as they relate to one another without understanding each other.

At 12 years old, Olivia's daily life is turned upside down overnight. She must get used to a more modest lifestyle and look after her brother Tim on her own. Fortunately, meeting their welcoming and lively neighbours transforms their world into a genuine adventure film!
Life repeats itself every day while the succession of moments that we endlessly repeat is never the same.
A harried thirty-something woman is forced to decide whether she wants to be a mother after unexpectedly giving birth to her reproductive organs at her sister’s baby shower.

films.t: Očima Franze Kafky: Mezi obrazem a jazykem
films.syn: Experience Kafka’s vision through a dynamic fusion of image and word. This captivating spot for the international exhibition brings his era to life with mesmerizing collage animation.

Where does the Pantagruel come from? One day, a strange bird dropping rips through the sky’s strata and crashes to the ground, fertilising the soil. The medlars swell, and nature’s balance shifts. Mutations multiply and suddenly laughter breaks out.

A positive look at menopause. While different women confide how they experienced this natural and important passage in their lives, a female character tames her new environment and welcomes new ways of perceiving and projecting her femininity.

June 2013, it’s time for the eagerly-awaited event at the Youth Cultural Center in city Brique-sur-mer: the end-of-year drama class show. Through a chain of untimely events, the two stars of the play find themselves stuck outside the theatre hall.

25-year-old Luna decides to meet men outside her current relationship. She is traumatised by a violent ex-boyfriend. She doesn’t understand men’s behaviour and ends up stuck in unsatisfying, objectifying and violent relationships.

films.t: Pixar Animation Studios Spotlight – To "Elio"... And Beyond!
films.syn: Les réalisatrices d' Elio , Madeline Sharafian, Domee Shi et Mary Alice Drumm, projetteront des images exclusives du film de 2025 ; Docter dévoilera les premières images de Hoppers et de Toy Story 5 . À l'occasion du 30 e anniversaire de Toy Story , Docter dévoilera au public des images rares des coulisses du film.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Séances événements 2025) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: A clay sculpture comes to life in the gloomy darkness of a workshop, surrounded by strange creatures...

Remembering is a fluid affair. A daughter tries to reconcile with her mother through memories of their shared rituals, exposing the intricate aspects of their relationship. As the daughter matures, she begins to contemplate conventional notions of divinity.

Cette anthologie suit trois des guerriers les plus féroces de l'histoire de l'humanité : une Viking qui guide son jeune fils dans une quête sanglante de vengeance, un ninja du Japon féodal qui se retourne contre son frère samouraï dans une bataille brutale pour la succession, et un pilote de la Seconde Guerre mondiale qui s'envole pour enquêter sur une menace d'un autre monde pesant sur la cause des Alliés. Mais si tous ces guerriers sont des tueurs à part entière, ils ne sont que des proies pour leur nouvel adversaire, le tueur ultime des tueurs. Predator : Killer of Killers

ap.sel: Officially selected (Séances événements 2025) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: Leaving their human hosts, mental disorders take on anthropomorphic forms and find new refuges.
When it’s time for a bath, Pucio will do anything to keep playing. When he meets a muddy crocodile looking for the bathroom, the two will set out on a bubbly adventure together.
In the middle of the night, on a mountain road, a man was struck down in a motorcycle accident. This was the cue.
Two creatures meet on a tree. Their encounter goes deep down to the roots and beyond.

Rejoignez Raphael Bob-Waksberg, scénariste et producteur, pour une conversation sur ses débuts en tant qu'artiste, sa carrière et son parcours créatif depuis BoJack Horseman et Undone jusqu'à la prochaine comédie de Netflix, Long Story Short .

ap.sel: Officially selected (Séances événements 2025) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: It's your first rave tonight. Your movements plunge you into the memory of that night. You experience it as if you were there, but beware: you must make your way through the forest. Once there, the more you dance, the more the world changes.

This examines the human condition through the lens of war, suffering, and death in the Middle East. Inspired by my dreams and personal experiences as a Syrian refugee. The film raises existential questions about life, death, and the search for meaning.
Explore the evolution of the Odakyu Romancecar from the 1960s to the present day. Enjoy the diverse cityscapes and landscapes from the different train carriage windows.

A man recounts his capillary peregrinations through his adolescence from trauma at the barbers to his first love, then to the loss of his hair and eventually the loss of his father. Through this journey, we see a construction of masculinity in the making.
One ordinary summer day, a child living in the Anatolian countryside kills a bird with his slingshot and is drawn into a whirlwind of intense emotions as he feels deep remorse.

Inspired by fragments of poems by Sappho (Island of Lesbos, 600 BC), the first female author known to the Western World. The narrative alludes to Sappho’s poetic expressions and the multiple readings of her figure throughout history.

A woman offers a lock of hair to her magical puppet theatre. She turns the crank handle, and it gives her a gift, the artifact absorbs her into a performance of puppets and insects where her presence will illuminate life.

A young girl is a victim of child abuse by someone close to her family, her behaviour and attitude change. Her mom notices and talks to her, this is the only way the abuse can stop. 85% of child abuse cases are committed by a person close to the victims.

The true story of Ahlam, a teenage mother who fled Iraq, impelled by a desire for freedom. The narrator shares her memories on a metaphorical journey in an airport, where dreams and ghosts of the past intertwine.
Faced with an infinitely vast reality and an infinitely deep space-time, human history is extremely small. Reality and history are no longer real and are on the verge of collapse.

films.t: Show Your Working – London International Animation Festival 2024
films.syn: An exploration of the time and labour involved in the creation of any animated film. A journey from the beginnings of life on Earth, on a detour through the advent of animation, and finally into our technological future, all through the medium of knitting.

Claudie is passionate about her unusual job: scanning the cosmos for signs of extraterrestrial life, hoping to make contact. Completely absorbed in her mission, she gradually loses touch with those around her, and even reality itself could fade away.

Set in a small theater at the end of the silent film era, a former movie star clings to the past by screening only silent films. His son grows up in this world, unaware of the changes beyond its walls, until a discovery unsettles his beliefs.
A boy runs through a wild world, encountering mysterious creatures and following a bat that guides him forward.

A 40-year-old graffiti wall becomes an archaeological site and a sgraffito sculpture as skrffologists reveal hundreds of layers of colorful paint representing decades of artistic, political and cultural expression.

films.t: Smurfs x SpongeBob x Turtles: A Paramount Animation and Nickelodeon presentation
films.syn: En outre, ne manquez pas ces deux nouveaux courts métrages animés très prometteurs : SpongeBob: Order Up, réalisé par Sean Charmatz, et Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Chrome Alone 2 – Lost in New Jersey , par Kent Seki. Cowabunga !

ap.sel: Officially selected (Séances événements 2025) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: A soldier is heading to the battlefield and his encounters along the way become the foundation for his blissful imagination. After a devastating explosion on the battlefield, his vivid recollections of the past intermingle and culminate in a delirious haze.
The story about a polar bear in an unforgiving environment on his quest to find a friend.

Set in a bayou in the Southern United States and infused with an air of magical realism. Crouton, a hand-woven doll must deliver a mysterious package to the game’s protagonist, Hazel Flood, a curious and adventurous young woman.

Frankelda, une écrivaine mexicaine déterminée du XIX e siècle, plonge dans son subconscient pour affronter les monstres qu’elle a elle-même imaginés. Guidée par un prince tourmenté, elle doit rétablir l'équilibre entre la fiction et la réalité avant qu’il ne soit trop tard.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Annecy Présente 2025) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: He is the guardian robot programmed to raise Celeste, a bright star among astronauts. But when she is departing for her first interstellar mission, he is left to wonder… What now? A poignant music-filled tale about memories and the bonds that connect us. A tomorrow-days lullaby about finding your place in the universe.

Follow Arama, guided by a mystical pomegranate tree, meeting a mysterious man. Along the way, Arama faces parts of himself, slowly putting together the puzzle of his identity. Before he can put everything together, will he manage to keep himself in one piece?

Holly est une petite hérisonne qui vit avec son père trouillard dans un vieux phare. Walter est un lapin épuisé par ses 53 enfants. Tous deux rêvent parfois d'une vie plus trépidante. Jusqu'au jour où Holly croise le chemin d'un chat dératiseur et Walter perd la mémoire et se prend désormais pour Super Walter, le chevalier intrépide. C'est l'occasion rêvée pour Holly de partir pour une quête épique ! Une fantastique aventure familiale pour réveiller le héros qui sommeille en chacun de nous.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Annecy Présente 2025) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: A homage to the scientist Simon von Stampfer, who presented his invention of the stroboscopic discs in Vienna in 1833. They show all kinds of animated loops from abstract to figurative and from experimental to documentary and foreshadow the variety of genres in animated film.

films.t: Star Wars: Tales of the Empire "Devoted"
films.syn: Barriss Offee, once an enemy of the Republic, is inducted into the New Galactic Empire's division of Inquisitors.
A psychedelic battle between past and present, light and dark, and life and death plays out in the haunted psyche of an Imperial trooper who is on the cusp of defeat.

A family of cute rabbits live on a mini-planet. Emperor Jean-Yves Lapude orders them to leave and destroy their world. Captain Ken appears from space to save them, confronting the emperor with a daring ultimatum.

Dans son laboratoire de fortune au cœur du château Grotteskew, le plus fou des savants fous donne (presque) vie à sa toute dernière création monstrueuse. Tapi dans l’ombre, son tout premier cobaye, longtemps oublié, observe : Stitch Head, un petit être étrange composé de morceaux, de bric, de broc et de pièces détachées. Un jour, une troupe de monstres fatigués arrive en ville, menée par son propriétaire, Fulbert Freakfinder. Le spectacle a besoin d’une nouvelle attraction… et lorsque Freakfinder rencontre le modeste Stitch Head, il sait qu’il vient de trouver sa vedette.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Annecy Présente 2025) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: Official trailer for the StopTrik Festival 2024 (Maribor, Slovenia). The theme of this edition was "Transhumanism". Themes such as Anthropocene, destruction, environmentalism and nature, AI, science fiction, techno-optimism were alluded to in the trailer.

In the topsy turvy world of Backwoods, trash is cool, and carrots are the Best Food, wolves carry briefcases and hares don’t have hair, play is serious business, and friendship can be hard sometimes, but mostly life is a great adventure for Rooney and Hare!
In a society where beauty is revered like a deity, a doll seeks to find her place.

One evening, Alia and Neena, two young Indian women, dine at Sulaimani, an Indian restaurant in Paris. The meal stirs up buried emotions and "unleashes" certain memories that slowly reveal why they left their country

films.t: Tales from Outer Suburbia "Episode 3: Distant Rain"
films.syn: School is finished for the year! Siblings Klara and Pim are ready to enjoy the magic of the holidays; a summer of swimming pools, bindis, ice cream, hot chips and staying up late. But something extraordinary is happening in the usually mundane outer suburbia.

Three kids spend the night at their grandpa’s house. To fill the silence after losing their grandma, the family’s storyteller, they begin to create their own stories and discover the power of imagination. This uplifting film celebrates creativity and its healing magic.
Tapeworm Alexis helps Maria Callas rise to the 'Prima Assoluta' – a success story that ends in the biggest opera scandal of all time: the diva's voice fails, and the dream team has to go into hiding.
This Christmas, Santa is on the “naughty" list.
We join Mino on her 27 th birthday and through her eyes we observe her friend’s mental illnesses and disorders.
A silent, sandy impression of a secret affair between two Catholic priests. Their affection blooms between one bed of strawberries and another, in a garden next to an Italian rectory.

Dans ce nouveau volet explosif de la franchise signée DreamWorks Animation, les Bad Guys, en quête de rédemption, redoublent d’effort pour rester dans le droit chemin. Mais leurs bonnes résolutions volent en éclats alors qu’ils se retrouvent malgré eux embarqués dans un braquage de grande envergure aux quatre coins du globe, mené par une nouvelle équipe de criminelles aussi redoutables qu’imprévisibles : les Bad Girls.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Séances événements 2025) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: A child goes carp fishing, but he has the bad idea of bringing his little dog with him. Between the puppy, a frog and a duck, catching a fish isn’t easy.
A forgotten Polish neighborhood drowns in the haze of coal mine smoke. A young man shaves his head, dons a tracksuit, and faces his brother's shadow and the weight of his past.

A comedic romp through plague-torn Italy in the 1300s. We created a storm of mischievous rats that swarm and scatter to tell stories of desire, escape, sickness, hope, desperation, prayer, lust, and re-birth… all in the face of impending death.

If traditionally the animator is a master illusionist, conjuring motion through static mediums, what does this process look like when they are given a machine of infinite images? This journey is fueled by the conflicting nature of AI technology.

In a world suspended between dreams and reality, toys tirelessly repeat their mechanical tasks. A toy bear, unexpectedly delivered to this enigmatic village, begins to observe its peculiar rhythms and gradually uncovers the hidden rules and lurking dangers.
Astrid and her only friend Crow sit waiting in a world of all that is forgotten.

Stark conformity dominates the residents of a large manor house. Identical figures eat the same, move the same, look the same. But everything changes when one woman gets given an orange by a strange figure. She has never seen an orange.

A collaborative animation bringing together astronomers under the guidance of an animator and an astrophysicist. As the 2024 solar eclipse approached, participants unleashed their imagination to depict this celestial phenomenon.
For the past three months, Candice has been exploding every day. Sometimes even two or three times a day. Her record is seven times. She is currently at 192 explosions.

films.ot: La jeune fille qui pleurait des perles
films.syn: A haunting fable about a girl overwhelmed by sorrow, the boy who loves her, and how greed leads good hearts to wicked deeds.

Qian Xiao, une jeune fille issue d’un modeste village de pêcheurs, entre en possession du "Cadran du Temps" à la suite d’une collision maritime accidentelle. Ce mystérieux artefact lui permet de contrôler le temps, mais attire également l’attention d’une puissante organisation bien décidée à la traquer. Tandis que Qian Xiao utilise le Cadran du Temps pour échapper à ses implacables poursuivants, elle croise la route de Seventeen, un membre de l’organisation criminelle. Leur affrontement initial se transforme peu à peu en une camaraderie inattendue, au fil d’aventures fantasques dans une ville en pleine effervescence.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Annecy Présente 2025) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: Two young women out for a walk follow a trail of coloured stones on the ground, which leads them to danger. They are trapped in the Mangittatuarjuk’s lair, the Gnawer of Rocks. The women are terrified when they realize what the monster has been doing.

The moment the first gleam of sunlight trickled in gently stirring the folds of a shallow sleep… that was when the graffiti appeared. The film brings a prose poem by Makoto Takayanagi to life, read here by the poet himself.

films.t: The Great Annual Party of the Creatures of the Moon
films.ot: Le Grand Party annuel des créatures de la Lune
films.syn: Humans have finally left the moon! LET'S PARTY! A cheerful film created on a pinscreen.

films.t: The Great History of Western Philosophy
films.ot: La gran historia de la filosofía occidental
