films.syn: A cosmic animator is hired by the Central Committee of the People's Republic to make a philosophical film under the gaze of Chairman Mao, who was displeased and sentenced them to death right at the start. Don’t worry, the sentence didn't stick as it was refuted by Monkey and Pigsy from "Journey to the West".

Autumn 2023. Akutsu, an elderly inmate serving life in prison, is on the verge of a lonely death in his single cell. A talking Housenka flower says to him, " What a rotten life you had ." Akutsu starts reflecting on his past. Summer 1986. Akutsu is living with Nana and her son Kensuke in a shabby apartment with a garden full of Housenkas. It is the tale of a one-night victorious comeback by a dying yakuza, and his family's story told by a flower that blooms in prison.

Rhythmic gymnastics is considered to be one of the most beautiful female sports. We see young, gorgeous girls in their glittering leotards moving lightly on a big carpet, smiling. Behind the mask of perfection, however, there is eternal self-dissatisfaction.

Sulina, 1910. It is the inauguration of the first electric power station in this Romanian port city. In the jubilation of a modern and cosmopolitan crowd, Ilarion, a prestidigitator from another time, tries to play his last card.

films.ot: El circo de los payasos bigotones
films.syn: In a Latin American country, a child’s notebook recounts a series of horrifying events that happened at the Big Moustache Clowns Circus. Presented as a children's horror story, it narrates the way in which tricks and torture were performed at the circus.

In the middle of the night, while his parents are entertaining friends, a child slips on his wellington boots and sneaks off into the woods. There, a strange solitary creature leads him into the heart of the forest to meet the nocturnal inhabitants.
After digging a tunnel on the beach, two kids from different sides of the world meet each other. Together, they dig their way to the North Pole, where they discover a magical way to go back home.

films.t: The Pool or Death of a Goldfish
films.syn: A story about a possessive relationship between a mother and her daughter. The daughter, through unexpressed anger and rebellion against her mother, transforms into a goldfish. Her repressed childhood emotions are manifested in her harshness towards herself and others.

It begins, as its name suggests, with heaven, and thus the almost biblical beginning of all beginnings. However, it is a man in work clothes who emerges from the cuboid floating through the air, and not a divine being.
The story is about a boy, Yu, and his teacher, whose story spans time, and details of their relationship.

Chile, 1883. In Pirque, a rumor spreads: deep within the dark and shadowy cellars of Viña Concha & Toro, the world’s finest wine is guarded by a fearsome presence… the Devil himself. A whisper becomes history, and history turns into legend.

Isak Borg is First Secretary of the Swedish Embassy in Pyongyang, so is constantly under surveillance and scrutiny. Borg has been secretly dating Bok-joo, a local traffic officer. They know their time is limited, so they cherish their secret meetings. One day, after a shady looking man visits their secret meeting spot, Bok-joo suddenly disappears. Bori searches for Bok-joo and becomes suspicious of his interpreter, Lee Myeong-jun.
In a city where people consume cartoons, a dog reconciles with its old friends, and together they try to escape from the humans.

films.t: The Tale of Tran Thanh Duong
dn: Hachul Le Do (Le Do Hai Chau)
films.syn: This is a world where men are fish, and women are shrimp. The Xẩm, Chèo-singing-influenced score prompts a conversation about the duality of identities: "Which body of water carries that which aren’t fish or shrimp?". A story about a species that is not fish or shrimp.

Tomek and Hannah meet on the way to the Qjar River. Hannah is hoping to collect a magic drop to save her bird, and Tomek is searching for a lost memory. Their quests overlap, follow one another, and finally complement each other.

How does society deal with offenders? What could you do to prevent victims? This deals with a difficult subject matter and gives a glimpse into the minds of two people who have committed criminal offenses.

Thelma, une jeune fille pingouin, défie les règles de son monde glacial qui n'autorise pas les célébrations personnelles, et se lance dans une aventure fantaisiste qui lui apprend ce que signifie devenir soi.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Annecy Présente 2025) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: Rooted in wetlands, páramos and centennial forests at the verge of disappearing, memories and a speculated future collide. Five hundred years of exploitation, exile and resilience are nourished by a collective pain and a desire to crack through it all.

films.t: Three Sisters – When Ancient Wisdom Beats Modern Industry
films.syn: As Chief Handsome Lake prepared for death, he had a vision. He was walking through a planted field and heard a woman call out. She told him that the recent devastation had left her and her sisters with little hope for the future, and they wanted to join him on his journey to death.

Every day, Tiddler creates a new story to entertain his classmates. One morning, while dreaming up his latest story, Tiddler gets lost in the middle of the ocean. He has no hope of getting home until he hears a familiar story and is saved by his own storytelling.

A couple of little mushroom fairies put on a magic show for Tiny Toot and her friends. They use their magic wands to shoot mycelium at the fallen fruit, turning it into fertile dirt to help new life grow. Tiny Toot also gets to try the magic wand and learns some mushroom magic.

films.t: Trailer: 22nd Sommets du cinéma d'animation de Montréal
films.ot: Bande-annonce : Les 22es Sommets du cinéma d'animation de Montréal
films.syn: As spring breathes in her first breath of the year, sunshine, flowers and life touch the vibrant city of Montreal.
A small prehistoric amphibian goes on a journey with the goal of finding its mate.
The story of a sleeping piece of paper that, after being awakened by the flapping wings of a Tsuru (Japanese bird origami), begins a challenging journey in search of transformation.

What a shitty picnic! In a muddy park, Father and Mother Ubu, sitting next to a dustbin, are envious of the families opposite. Mother Ubu pushes Father Ubu aside, not just to get a better seat... but to take over everything. Mayhem ensues.

Set to atmospheric jazz music by the Flemish-Norwegian band Donder, the viewer is drawn into a mysterious, visceral world where textures, shapes and notes all breathe in unison. A fusion of sculpture and animated narrative.

Approached with this meaningful project about bullying, we knew we had to handle it with care. Our goal was to bring sensitivity and impact to the story. Back-to-school season is a time of fresh starts, and we wanted to spark important conversations for kids and families.
As the east wind begins to blow, bringing warmth to the water, landscapes spill and blend together. In time, the mountains drift into a slumber.

Through a tribute to cinema, we presented safety and well-being information to the audience of one of the most important movie theaters in São Paulo, Brazil. Made entirely in stop-motion, the vignette is made up of rotoscoped scenes from great movie classics.
Panic, panic, fear and confusion in extreme situations.

films.t: Walt Disney Animation Studios – Welcome Back to Zootopia!
films.syn: Le directeur créatif des Studios d’animation Walt Disney, réalisateur et scénariste oscarisé Jared Bush ( Encanto ) fait ses débuts à Annecy en présentant son film Zootopie 2 , le 13 juin à Bonlieu Scène nationale. Dans ce film, dont la sortie est prévue pour le 26 novembre 2025, Judy Hopps et Nick Wilde sont confrontés à un nouveau mystère qui ébranle Zootopie. Par ailleurs, le légendaire réalisateur de Disney Ron Clements ( La Petite Sirène, Aladdin ) sera intronisé au Walk of Fame d'Annecy.

ap.sel: Officially selected (Séances événements 2025) - French-language official page only (no English version)

films.syn: Strung along by the backdrop of a hard-to-grasp outside world, we follow a life-size puppet who yearns to connect to its own rhythm. The rhythms of the city itself become a key contribution to the emotional movement.

films.t: Welcome to the City of Love
films.syn: Paris has never seen a love like this. It draws a close parallel between romantic love and the passion athletes feel for their sports. Watch as cyclists race through Montmartre and lovers dance on the Seine, as swimmers dive and couples embrace.

On a peculiar Christmas Eve, a devoted grandfather and his imaginative granddaughter bridge the distance between a bustling city and a quiet mountain village through the timeless magic of the postal service.
Her disappearance began in the early hours of one morning. We took the wrong suitcase at the airport before the typhoon hit. After that, her life and ours have continued like this.

Twiggy, a lively red squirrel, and Woody, a spirited great spotted woodpecker, share fascinating facts about the unsung heroes of nature—trees. Twiggy explains how trees are essential in combating climate change, reducing flooding, and creating cool, thriving ecosystems.
When a zombie apocalypse strikes, can a ragtag group of zoo animals set aside their carnal instincts to survive the undead — and also each other?
During a visit to a zoo, our gaze lingers on the last silhouettes and stories that still inhabit the place.

films.t: "King of the Hill – Season 15" Exclusive Screening
films.syn: First look at a never-before-seen episode of King of the Hill ahead of the season 15 Disney+ premiere, followed by a Q&A with Mike Judge, Greg Daniels and Saladin K. Patterson. King of the Hill is an Emmy‑winning animated comedy praised for its smart, character‑driven humor and cultural insight. The series returned in 2025 as a Hulu Original with its long‑awaited Season 14 revival, debuting to rave reviews. Season 15 will premiere on Disney+ this summer.

In 2009, a rural town in southern Philippines shocked the world with the Maguindanao Massacre, killing 57 people, including 32 journalists. For Reynafe Castillo, the toll is 58 — she still seeks recognition for her missing father, Reynaldo Momay.

This is a surreal Palestinian slice-of-life short. Through radio snippets and salon chatter, early teen Nara meets Ms Moodswings, the personified menstruation blood blob. A tapestry of interrupted life, where growing up unfolds amidst implied socio-political chaos.
In an attempt to identify itself, a body without a horse moves through its absences and voids.

films.t: A Couple Clucking Chickens Were Still Kickin' in the Schoolyard
films.ot: 庭には二羽ニワトリがいた。
films.syn: It is 2019 and aliens have nearly annihilated the human race. As humanity faces extinction, the aliens settle on Earth and even fully embrace human culture by living like humans once did. Alien student Yohei's is feeding the two chickens kept at his school but they are hiding a surprising secret.

When grandma's dog dies, granddaughter Luna helps with the burial. But what happens when you're dead and buried underground? Grandma evades the answer, so Luna is tempted to see for herself what's going on down there.
Here, we walk in Ida's shoes, a 72-year-old pianist living with dementia. This is a poetic experience about the long goodbye of two lovers who shared a life together.

aw: Cristal for the Best Immersive Work

films.t: A Masterclass with Ricky Gervais, Writer and Director of Netflix's "Alley Cats"
films.syn: Join multi-award-winning comedian, and creator of The Office and After Life , Ricky Gervais for a discussion on his upcoming outrageously funny adult animated comedy about a bunch of feral cats. Alley Cats is an animated sitcom created by and starring Ricky Gervais. The show follows the trials and tribulations of a group of feral British cats, who struggle to survive in an uncaring human world. From the funny to the absurd, it features Gervais' signature style of heart and social commentary that audiences have come to expect. As part of the discussion, Netflix will also give a world exclusive sneak peek of the first two episodes, ahead of the series debut this summer.

Young Keitaro lives inside an abandoned factory that was once surrounded by lush forest and now redeveloped with solar panels. Before the factory's demolition, he aims to launch his late father's firework with his brother and friend, closing a chapter.
A woman, living in a house that drifts like cosmic debris, wakes to find her right ear and her husband gone. To recover what was lost, she embarks on a surreal journey through the void.
A$AP Rocky and his constituents acquire a helicopter while being chased down by a SWAT team.

Set in a fictional city adrift in a vast acidic ocean. Over the course of one day, a film crew captures life in this isolated place through a mix of real interviews from New York, with scientists, responders, and everyday people, as well as imagined voices.

"Adage" is a ballet term which refers to a slow and graceful sequence of movements. The film seeks to juxtapose this with disorientating abstraction caused by process and editing. Varying levels of abstraction are created through process, playing with our associated perception of movement.
Abducted by a jungle tribe to undergo a brutal initiation, three teenage girls enter a divine realm where taming giant snakes – their totem animals – becomes a rite of passage into adulthood.

Agathe, aged 90, lives as a recluse in a snow-covered cabin. Frede, her daughter, visits her with the intention of bringing her closer to her in a nursing home in town. But between the disembowelled fox on the doorstep and her mother's disturbing behaviour, the visit takes a different turn.

On the first day of winter, two young stoats must learn to adapt to the new environment around them by shedding their summer coats and taking on their winter fur. What happens when, in addition to this struggle, human interference also comes into play and makes things even more complicated?

It's the moment after a big celebration, the party guests are falling asleep, the tinsel is scattered across the floor, the costumes wrinkled into colorful landscapes. An eerie spirit is in the air, a magical haze that guides us softly into the dreams we have yet to dream.
Clara Crocodilo, a ferocious crocodile music icon, comes back from the 80's to instil fear among traditional families in the popular parts of São Paulo.
An insomniac is forced out of bed and faces a sleepless night. She explores her inner world, which both torments and amazes her.

In Morocco, children grow up terrified of the legend of Aïcha Kandicha the witch. But Aïcha may have actually existed during the Portuguese colonisation of Morocco. This animated tale attempts to recreate her story.
Spoon finds a coupon!
A hot summer day brings several neighbours out onto their balconies. During a sudden rainstorm, one of them gets a burst of inspiration, which encourages the rest to live in the moment.

Life throws curveballs, how you react decides if you make it through. We follow an elementary schoolgirl terrified of sports who survives a chaotic ball game by bouncing a ball off her face. By the end of the game, she’s completely transformed.

In Batman: Knightfall Part 1: Knightfall , when the mysterious behemoth known only as Bane frees Batman's entire Rogue's Gallery from Arkham Asylum, the Caped Crusader is pushed to his mental and physical breaking point.
When a lantern lights up on a country road in the jungle, a group of insects go crazy. This comes in handy for the hungry bats in a cave nearby.
It's Saturday, and a woman struggles with the difficulty of reconciling her home life and her need to escape.
A lonely man, obsessed with two performing poodles, attends a dog show and crosses a line, risking public shame for the fragile hope of being seen by the only ones he truly admires.

An elderly photographer pores over old photographs, trying to reconnect his broken memories with the people they depict. It is a quiet requiem for a bygone era — a reflection on how futile it is to try to preserve people just as they were.

The Sauvage family just wants to be loved. Carole knows her staff hate her. Jacques, her husband, feels belittled, and their son Blaise is a 16-year-old introvert who lacks conviction, always tentatively agrees… just as he does with Joséphine. He too is an activist and is ready to cause mayhem!

A tough, no-nonsense Buffalo has always seen himself as strong and fearless. But when his dream of fatherhood comes true, he's suddenly awkward, overwhelmed, and under constant judgment. Can he become the father he's always imagined or will his fears hold him back?
Patouille is a wonderful little creature who lives in tune with plants. Alongside her friend Momo, she discovers the incredible characteristics of plants.

Vajk, a deaf teenager, controls his connection to the world through his hearing aid. His older brother drags him out of his comfort zone and takes him to a concert by a mysterious band. In the crowd, he loses control and lets himself go to the rhythm as he discovers his inner voice.

During the late 1950s in Venezuela, nine-year-old Elizabeth's summer takes a wild turn when her little brother Leo disappears into the jungle. She must trade her books for bravery to find him and rescue a mystical furry animal, bringing it back to the legendary Tepui mountain.

Kona, a forest cat, sets out to find her missing mother, kidnapped by dogs serving humans. She is joined by Colin, a puppy, and Bernard, a runaway bear. Together they search for lost families. Different at first, they face danger and learn to trust each other on a journey that changes them forever!

In a zombie world, Boi and Gal awaken into humanity after consuming a mysterious broccoli. As civilisation rises from love and loss, Boi builds technology to "save" Gal from reverting to a zombie state. But as progress accelerates, Gal begins to question whether being human truly means domination.

In a city where wearing a bucket is mandatory, a man puts it on each day to protect his stable "life". He blacks out documents belonging to complete strangers. One day, after a minor accident, his bucket comes off — and he notices an old man making strange claims.

A rabbit man wanders into a city, it's very windy and raining labels. He proceeds down the main street with an umbrella, irritated by his situation. Then a guy in a car talks to him and takes the rabbit man to a hotel.

films.t: CALM, the Last Tale of Horacio Quiroga
films.ot: CALM, el último cuento de Horacio Quiroga
films.syn: Horacio Quiroga, often called the Edgar Allan Poe of Latin American literature, becomes the hero of his final tale. In a Buenos Aires hospital, memories and hallucinations blur reality as characters from his stories appear in a journey through love, madness and death.

Ame loves sweets and lives with Caries, a lively cavity inhabiting her mouth. Despite the chaos Caries causes, the two share a fun, wild life. Together, they embark on crazy adventures – fighting evil dentists and saving the town in their exciting daily lives.
Living for her acrobatic passion, legless Carla rebels against contemporary social norms.

When a four-year-old girl discovers a dead bird in the garden, her mother is swept into a world where reality unfolds like a cartoon. Inspired by a poem by Nick Flynn, this film is a meditation on a mother's attempt to protect her daughter's sense of wonder.
Inspired by historical events, this episodic film explores the role of chance in human life and death.

New York, 1941. After his father mysteriously disappears, Steven sets out to investigate with Miriam, an Austrian refugee and avid detective novel enthusiast. Their search soon leads them to the heart of a vast conspiracy.

films.ot: Entotsu Machi no Poupelle – Yakusoku no Tokeidai
films.syn: After losing his dearest friend Poupelle, the boy Lubicchi cannot let go of his hope of reunion. One day, he slips into a wondrous world called the Millennium Fortress. A clock tower frozen at 11:59 holds a forgotten promise. To return home, he must restart it – and find the courage to believe again.
While on a quest for spiritual enlightenment (and getting laid...), Chip takes on a megalomaniac cult leader with a passion for breeding and decorative gravel.

Peter spends Christmas in the countryside and reunites with his summer friends. But a terrifying Robot-Santa hijacks the holiday and is ruining the children's wish lists. When Gerda vanishes into the Frog Kingdom, Peter must stop Robot-Santa or Christmas will be ruined forever.

Carole loves Christmas and is a staunch upholder of its traditions. Through her son André's eyes, this devotion takes on an imaginary dimension: her culinary creations become gateways into extraordinary realms, where festive magic and food intertwine, celebrating solidarity and transmission.

César, involuntarily committed to a psychiatric institution, searches for a way out. Amidst repressed memories and dreamlike visions, he seeks the memory of the man he loved, a safe haven amid the suffering of his fading days.
A very tiny fish sails in a vast underwater city. Is he too small to see the world like the big ones do?
A woman has a frog inside her that keeps demanding more and more space.

Sales Team 3 is made the scapegoat for the chairman's embezzlement scandal. The team leader attempts to reveal the truth, but the manipulation of evidence by a key executive pushes the entire team to the brink of collective dismissal.

ap.sel: Officially selected (2026 Feature Films: Midnight Specials)

films.syn: A surreal swarm of drones is scavenging for e-waste. Drawing on the speculative frameworks of climate fiction the film addresses the geopolitics of waste. It contemplates current warfare and the entanglement of ecological and geopolitical conditions.

In his toy-cluttered bedroom, while his hamster nonchalantly runs in its wheel, a child is busy building a rocket. His father spends his evenings smoking cigarettes under the starry sky, his mother is busy in the kitchen and garden. Louis prepares for take-off.
On an intergalactic cruise for singles, lonely souls chase a kiss, a caress, or just a glimpse of love among the stars.
A lonely businessman attempts to find connection in an online chatroom, despite his peculiar and specific fetish of wanting to be a tennis ball.

The Hungarian word "alkotás" (artwork) has a dual meaning – it can refer both to the process of creation and to the finished artwork. The film tells the story of how a canvas comes alive, how playful, abstract forms are created, each one carrying its own human narrative.

Coeur Vert Nez Rouge is a hospital clowns association who help in child psychiatry. The film of the same name is an awareness-raising film produced through a skills-based sponsorship initiative by Tulipes & Cie for the association, with the aim of supporting them and drawing attention to their work.

From Warner Bros. Pictures Animation, Daffy Season a Looney Tunes short film. Daffy is ready for Duck Season, but Elmer is too immersed in his new obsession – soccer – to come hunting. Slowly the world around Daffy turns into a zombie-esque nightmare as the Tunes become obsessed with the sport.

Resurrected by sinister muses, an army emerges from the darkness sounding the trumpets of war. In this apocalyptic nightmare, Shostakovich's music drags us into a violent maelstrom of terror, destruction and human suffering.
10 million euros go missing and the prime suspect is forced to flee and ends up in the city dump. In the search for the truth, two heads clash – but what price friendship?

After the death of their ill-tempered and controlling father, two middle-aged sisters find themselves at a loss. An unexpected visitor sparks the courage in them to begin their lives anew. This is a merry, rude and lyrical adaptation of the modernist short story of the same name, written by Katherine Mansfield in 1920.
It's late night in São Paulo. Álvaro takes on a job caring for a terminal patient – but death seeps through the rooms of the mysterious old building.

I am grateful to the Chinese for the invention of gunpowder – it feels as if they made it for me. Its discovery happened by accident, originally conceived as a way to ward off evil spirits. This film begins in China, then moves to an event in Cartagena and ends centuries later in Bogotá.

Arnold, an unemployed mouse, is in the midst of an existential crisis. He lives in a city where the A.L.M.A. corporation controls everything. Unlike his wife María, he has always had the impression that this world is unreal. Determined to rebel, he hatches a cunning plan to escape the city.

In two creative parallel worlds, two distinct forces journey through their realms. As their paths converge, their worlds merge into a singular universe where imagination knows no boundaries, embodying the transformative spirit of the Design and Animation School.

films.t: Detention's Ripple Effect: Why Inhumanity Breeds Hatred
films.syn: This animation reveals how torture violates international law and breeds hatred, undermining peace. It reminds authorities that upholding detainee dignity and humane standards is crucial for mental health, societal safety, and preventing systemic abuse essential for future stability.

A stylised opening sequence where combat becomes choreography: Dante bursts forth into a world of blood-red silhouettes, combining iconic poses with exhilarating action.This opener for the Netflix series Devil May Cry captures the essence of the saga in one adrenaline-fuelled shot.
It shows the process of two people meeting, becoming lovers, and transforming into a dining experience.

We follow Dino, a big-hearted, not-so-bright dinosaur as he tackles basic life skills… badly. From befriending his own boogers to vacuuming soup, Dino's chaos is met with kindness and laughter, turning every disaster into a funny, teachable moment.

films.t: Dive into "THE GHOST IN THE SHELL"
films.syn: In the year 2029, Motoko Kusanagi, a full-body cyborg, begins leading the offensive crime-prevention unit "Shell Squad" at the request of Daisuke Aramaki of the Ministry of Internal Affairs.
What happens when Doggie and Pussycat get a craving for cake? They take everything they like best to eat and mix it all together. But will it be edible?

films.t: DreamWorks presents: Discovering Nakalimutan, the Forgotten Island
films.ot: DreamWorks présente : À la découverte de Nakalimutan, l’Île des souvenirs
films.syn: Join writers and directors Joel Crawford and Januel P. Mercado for an in-depth preview of the artistry and technology behind the making of DreamWorks Animation's Forgotten Island . Based on and inspired by the people in their lives, writers and directors Joel Crawford and Januel P. Mercado have spent nearly six years fine-tuning and crafting the story of Forgotten Island . Set against the backdrop of Filipino mythology, the story centres on the power of friendship and the memories that make us who we are. Crawford and Mercado will delve into the making of the film, highlighting the work of over 400 world-class artists.

films.t: Dudley & the Invasion of the Space Slugs
films.syn: Dudley is a teenage frog who lives a peaceful life by the edge of his pond with his friends, meanwhile his parents are worried about his future. But when aliens land on Earth, Dudley's world is thrown into chaos. What if he has what it takes to become a hero and save the whole of humanity?
Magdelaine and her grandmother live a secluded life in their inn in the middle of the mountains. One cold night, as a violent storm rages outside, a traveler knocks at the door.

In a forgotten lab, a brilliant, obsessed inventor creates the Hatchling. Fragile yet promising, it becomes both cherished and tested. As care turns to control, the film questions the cost of perfection and whether love can outlast obsession.
A colorful bunch of organic waste gathers in the compost bin to create a groovy beat.

aw: Jury Award for a Commissioned Film

films.syn: High in the skies lies a playground where the children of gods and monsters play. Among them is Yios, eager to make friends but who struggles to control his explosive solar energy. When Yios accidentally falls to Earth, he experiences a life-changing encounter.

films.t: El Cuarteto de Nos "En el cuarto de Nico"
films.syn: In the intimacy of Nico's room lies a universe of nostalgia, reflected in every object carefully placed in his space. His cat Adorno finds a mysterious key and roams the room to discover what it belongs to.

An anxious monster spots a bug and thinks it has crawled out of his brain. A simple chase turns into a spiraling adventure through shifting landscapes, where nothing stays still — not even his sense of self.

films.t: Equity in the Workplace: The Experiences of Black Irish Women in Academia and Teaching Profession
films.syn: A glimpse into the Equity book on the lived experiences of Black Irish Women in Academia illustrating different ways of racism. The urgent message is that representation is not a privilege, it's a right.

Painted formless figures haunt recent photos of certain emptied-out public spaces. These smear frames perform repetitive movements expressing a frantic energy felt in our current moment. Figures become displaced from their locations as their environments dissolve and their printed record evaporates.

The life of 13-year-old Camille is turned upside down when she is transported into Gwendalavir, another world. A land inhabited by extraordinary and dangerous creatures that she must explore with her friend Salim, to uncover the truth about where she comes from and what her destiny holds.

When Nina and her best friend Lily decide to steal an eyeliner, they hope that this will be their key to womanhood. When they're given wildly different receptions to wearing it, Nina discovers that her journey as a trans girl might not be so easy.

An escaped prisoner flees into the Icelandic countryside. After their friends mysteriously vanish, E is pulled into a space where time and nature move differently. Featuring motion captured circus artists and real-time animation, this is Iceland's first film made for virtual reality.

The wanderer traverses a vast icy desert. He strives for a place that seems to be merely an illusion, like a ghost seeking a return to the world of the living. The lynx follows him, awaiting a moment when the vagabond loses all his strength.
Rejected by everyone, a woman follows a mysterious finger into a surreal realm, where a tender yet unsettling touch slowly begins to twist her reality.
A gas station attendant unexpectedly forms a bond with an ordinary fish. From this seemingly trivial encounter emerges a series of unsettling events.

Amid urban alienation and constant agitation, a solitary figure plays the trumpet. Words and images loop through an upside-down reality where real and fake collapse, and identity must be endlessly proven through familiar automated rituals.
A simple itch descends into an outbreak with many legs. Certain things will always find their way to the surface.

While celebrating their last night together, Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the island of Nakalimutan, packed with all the mythological creatures they grew up hearing stories about from their Filipino families.
A starving, broke student finds a discount coupon for the bakery across the street. But her moment of joy is brief. To use it, she’ll have to race against the clock and the city’s vermin.

films.t: Friss Kakas Animation Film Days Spot
films.syn: A promotional film created for the premiere screening event of the latest MOME Animation diploma films, which were presented at the Friss Kakas Animation Film Days in Budapest.

A re-examination of the Expulsion from Paradise. Using MoCap to reconstruct unpleasant sensations, this is a neurotic journey to confront self-rejection and transform sub-personalities. A psychological self-portrait turning somatic trauma into a gift of unconditional love.

films.t: From Live Action to Animation: The Creative Process of "ViQueens"
films.syn: This is the first animated feature from Director Harald Zwart ( The Karate Kid, The Mortal Instruments, Agent Cody Banks, The Pink Panther 2 ) and Producer Veslemøy Ruud Zwart ( The 12th Man, Troll ), created under their banner Zwart Arbeid. With voices by Ella Purnell, Rita Ora and Alan Carr, the film brings a playful, cinematic energy to a story grounded in real places, history, and mythology. I t follows two young Vikings who set sail to return a Chinese stowaway to his home – an adventure that takes them far beyond the world they know. Along the way, what begins as a bold mission turns into something more personal, as they start to see their own culture through new eyes. The stories they've grown up with don't quite hold up, and the idea that "everybody loves Vikings" begins to unravel. ViQueens balances humor and spectacle with a coming-of-age story about perspective, identity, and change. It's about realizing that you're not bound by the past – and that you can choose a different way forward. As the Emperor puts it: " Every generation is a new beginning ."
Through the author's memories and personal perspective, her stories of street adventures unfold, revealing the harsh, yet resilient reality of growing up in a neglected social environment.

In 18th-century rural France, a huntress is tracking down her former lover, a vampire who lives in plain view disguised as a nun. Consumed by rage, the huntress is determined to put an end to this toxic love affair – in a breathtaking fight scene.

14-year-old Zain, a Palestinian swimming champion, faces war and man-made famine. He becomes the sole caregiver to his little brother. When aid drops into the sea, desperate for food, Zain is forced to swim — not for passion, but for survival.

A seemingly ordinary childhood seen through the eyes of a little boy. Hand-drawn charcoal animation and intense sound reveal a fearful home that keeps him constantly alert. The film conveys the child’s bodily experience, inspired by the real childhood memories of several adults.
Providence, 11, and her guinea pig Airbag find themselves in possession of a magic pen that makes everything written with it come true. With this superpower, they embark on an incredible journey.

While travelling by train, Ariel and Paul are having some fun drawing their greatest fears when Gilda, a mysterious passenger, sits down with them and joins in. However, her own experience of fear does not seem to be as innocent as their drawings.

aw: Audience Award for a Short Film

films.syn: When an American air raid kills their mother in the final days of World War II, Seita and his kid sister Setsuko are left to fend for themselves in the devastated Japanese countryside. With food running short, the siblings can only cling to fleeting moments of happiness in their harsh reality.
The discovery of a human skull fragment plunges Gregor into a hallucinatory thriller blending violence, power, and extreme fantasies...

ap.sel: Officially selected (2026 Feature Films: Midnight Specials)

films.syn: A grey man can see the colors on others. Obsessed with their beauty, he tries to please people to connect with them. Repeated failures cause him to lose himself, leaving him an exhausted, hollow shell.

As dawn breaks, a loveliness of ladybirds takes to the sky… all except Bug. Left behind and unable to fly, Bug and a sympathetic Spider wrestle against an invisible weight that feels heavier than gravity alone.

One woman's search for love and meaning in a hellscape of waning fertility, dating apps and the rotten stench of the patriarchy. In a world where being yourself makes you monstrous, what is the cost of compromise and repressing your authentic self?

films.t: Here's to 100 Years of Circuit Breakers
films.syn: Orchestrated through a heartwarming animation, Smith and Foulkes craft a playful yet impactful journey, illustrating how Schneider Electric's circuit breaker seamlessly steps in when it's needed the most.

On her weekly trips to the swimming pool, Neema, a young immigrant to Iceland, stands out so much that she melts into a puddle. As she strives to stay solid, she realises that she is not the only one struggling with loneliness and grief.
Love, sex, desire, trauma, fantasy, spiritual ideas and peace. The power of the brain, the subconscious. An end of life story, to give joy to herself and those she loves.

A crow drops pebbles into a pitcher, coaxing water to rise — an ancient fable that still shimmers with truth. This film follows the mystery and brilliance of corvids, a family of bold songbirds whose intelligence reveals the wonder hidden in the everyday.

This film emerged from the rhythm and textures of a piece of music by Vern Avola called Trigger Object . It's a study of locomotion, growth and societal collapse in the form of an animated walk cycle.
When a baby cries, they should be fed. A good mother wouldn't let them die of hunger. A good father wouldn't wish to murder him.

This film centers on the fantasies and inner monologues of Li Yangqiao, a blasting miner trapped underground awaiting rescue. It draws the audience into the harsh and dangerous working conditions of miners, as well as their inner worlds.
A man lists the things that he has.

films.t: I'm Glad I know That Now Thank You: Phones
films.syn: This is a completely serious and educational series. It covers many different topics from how babies are made to why old men's ear lobes are so long.

To save the legendary but run-down comedy club Il Baracchino, Claudia recruits a crew of dysfunctional comedians. This mockumentary follows their uphill battle to stay open, turning the club's restoration into a journey of healing and lost goodbyes.

An animated documentary that explores gender identity through the lens of body imagery. The film delves into the evolving perceptions of a transgender gay man, highlighting the fluidity and complexity of gender identity.

In Los Angeles, high-school student AJ meets Kristen. She adores surfing, and he loves skateboarding. They fall madly in love. Their love story takes an unexpected turn when Kristen falls ill. Fuelled by their love, their friends' support and shared passion for surfing, they embark on a journey to overcome adversity together.
In a dark and lonely chamber, Dasnein is born — a grotesque insect who tries to satisfy his most onanistic instincts through a hypnotic screen that displays the lustful and chaotic world of Panium.
An interactive virtual reality musical experience inspired by the life of Henry Darger, a world-renowned "outsider artist" whose work remained unknown until his death.

In a quiet studio, a little monkey opens its eyes. Everything around it seems frozen in time. On a computer screen, it sees a jungle glowing in the distance, almost as if it were real. So, the monkey and its friends set about creating their own jungle, brought to life by their imagination.

A tactile, stop-motion poem built from decayed 16mm film, dried kombucha SCOBYs, and bubbling ferments. Treating animation as a process of transformative decay, the film traces inherited rituals and the residue of care. It attends to what persists as memory and language fade.

In rural France, 10-year-old Christophe is destined to follow his father on the family farm. But he begins to lean and collapse without warning, on the tractor, at school, at dinner. Forced to wear a corset to stay upright, he discovers music and meets Clara, with whom everything seems possible.

aw: Audience Award for a Feature Film

films.syn: An immigrant saying "Hello" to unknown lands. A recreation of old fantasy video games through irony, in which the protagonist and his Wizard guide companion, face strange situations that allude to the absurd nature of the immigrant's journey.

films.ot: 天幕のジャードゥーガル
films.syn: In 13 th -century Iran, a girl named Sitara is sold into slavery but taken in by scholars who teach her the "power of knowledge". As Genghis Khan's vast Mongol Empire sweeps across continents and reaches her city, Sitara's fragile peace is shattered, and her destiny as a "witch" is set in motion.

This is an animated short film that uses daily driving practice as a narrative medium. Through lifelike scenes and delicate character interactions, it showcases the warmth and conflicts in ordinary life. The film revolves around five characters with vastly different personalities.

Wide-eyed Julián is about to spend the summer with a grandmother he barely knows. He is amazed to discover her treasure-trove apartment, his own Caribbean heritage and the lively Brooklyn community he is surrounded by, but most surprising of all, Julián discovers that he is, in fact, a mermaid!
Diplomacy fails and tensions mount when two cultural icons battle for no reason. In this blockbuster action adventure, egos explode on two islands — one volcanic, the other municipal.

When Lou, a gentle purple creature with an embarrassingly stretchy trunk, rescues Kiri, an ungrateful little dinosaur, from a flood, they're swept into the greatest adventure in prehistory! They hurtle down a rushing river, cross the ocean, travel inside a giant sea creature and outrun an erupting volcano — discovering that you can find friendship in the wildest places.

In a underground world where mankind has been punished for daring to open the Black Egg, a father and son live in seclusion, lit only by the light of a fireplace. Petit's dream is to break out of this prison and discover what lies inside the Black Egg.

films.t: La Petite Robe noire : le Parfum
films.syn: In Paris by night, La Petite Robe noire enters a bistro full of roses. A bewitching encounter ensues: the dress swirls, seduces and bewilders. A dance of fabric and petals conveys the fragrance's sensuality and its bottle's spirit.

In a living room, Chilly Gonzales, JeanJass, Juliette Armanet and Tedax Max are still recovering from their wild night out. Chilly Gonzales is woken up by the TV's glow, and the video cassette starts playing with a medley of memories from the previous night and hallucinations are set to music.

In 2040, at the abandoned Messejana Lake, a pair of egrets struggles to find a safe place to nest and protect their eggs as a large-scale construction project brings workers and heavy machinery dangerously close.

This interactive virtual reality artwork and video game immerses the user in the experiences of a lesbian girl. It's an ode to sexual orientation and love with a serious issue: the discrimination that lesbians still face today.

Join Peter Lord, Nick Park, David Sproxton and special guests for a special opening session celebrating Aardman's unique approach to storytelling, comedy and craft. From early kitchen table experiments to iconic characters and award-winning productions, the team will share how their distinctive, handmade process has evolved over the years. Through a combination of archival material, behind-the-scenes footage and conversation, the session offers insight into how Aardman continues to create award-winning animation that connects with audiences around the world, as well as what lies ahead for the studio as it evolves its craft to embrace the next 50 years.

During a mission, the Awakeners Squad is ambushed by a horde of Extremal Beasts. Team member Mai Duo awakens her latent power and charges into the fray with her Six Harmony spear, embodying the strength of women in a post-apocalyptic wasteland and the fusion of Eastern and Western combat aesthetics.

Shut away in an attic, a neglected little girl escapes into a promising miniature world, until she uncovers its terrible secrets: a monster lurks behind every shadow. Based on the Little Nightmares universe, the award-winning video game series.

This is an animated comedy from the creator of BoJack Horseman about a family, over time. It's about the inside jokes, sibling rivalries, old wounds and shared history. In this episode, to crush the competition at a potluck, Shira tries making knishes – her mother's most difficult recipe.

films.t: Love, Death + Robots "How Zeke Got Religion"
films.syn: The Emmy-winning anthology of twisted tales from strange worlds returns, with stories featuring MrBeast and the Red Hot Chili Peppers. In this episode, on a perilous mission into hostile territory, the crew of a World War II bomber encounters an unholy enemy.

Lucy lives with her family in a village on a small, isolated island. She is rejected by the villagers because of her extraordinary gifts. When she meets Milly – a little girl whom only she can see – Lucy sets off on a great adventure to uncover the secret of her mysterious powers.

Triple Oscar-winner Richard Williams' last film – Lysistrata – is the sequel to Prologue , which had its world premiere in Annecy in 2015. Set in ancient Greece, it is the story of women who want to stop their menfolk from fighting in a war between Athens and Sparta. Organised by their leader Lysistrata and her bawdy friend Kalonike, the women gather to discuss going on a sex strike. Richard Williams hand-drew over 9,000 animation drawings for the film. As well as directing and animating the film, Williams is the voice of Kalonike, while Meera Syal stars as Lysistrata.

After waking up from a nightmare, Gil discovers that he can learn to control his dreams with the help of his boyfriend. Together they journey through strange dreamscapes and discover that the worst dreams are the ones they don't want to wake up from.
The daily life of a family living in Polynesia, during the period of nuclear fire. It is a testimony, meant to preserve the memory of a tragedy, long overlooked.

If you see a purple rabbit in Max’s arms, you might think it's just a cuddly toy. You'd be wrong! Lapin is a REAL rabbit — at least to Max. Partners in adventure and dreams, they share everything from secrets, advice, comfort and they even squabble (but obviously, only Max knows all this).
A twisted utopia unfolds, as singing cherubs melt to the sound of decay. Crafted by a sentient machine from the future, it unveils its own version of paradise.
The story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, unleashed monsters onto the world and banded together to save the planet.
This is a love story between two people who will never meet. A transgender girl explores an overlap of gender and sexual fantasy as she recalls a brief interaction with a stranger at a bus stop.

A risograph animated project designed to unsettle an audience through combined sounds and visuals. This project is inspired by an aural disorder, and intends to distress the audience with a soundscape composed of these trigger noises and accompanying visuals.
Mom is the name of a little girl living her childhood in Cambodia. She is also the mom of the filmmaker. She remembers the island, her mom, sister, the Khmer Rouge…

Mia has always been obsessed with the creepy and strange, so when she gets involuntarily transferred to a school full of real-life monsters, she finally fits in and can embrace her own uniqueness… until she uncovers a chilling plan that puts all humans in danger.
Being a mother is one of life's greatest mysteries.

films.ot: Muyi, la légende du village des femmes
films.syn: Muyi, 14, lives on a Chinese secluded mountain, forbidden to men. On the Day of the Dead, she invites a traveling troupe to perform the famous play The Handsome Genera l. But the play awakens old secrets and quickly brings chaos to the village.
When my body suddenly started breaking out in a rash, I naturally assumed at first that it was a skin problem. But what if the cause of my itching was actually something to do with my stomach?

A thrilling and original mix of folklore and adventure about a young minotaur boy (half boy half bull) found and raised in the human world. With the help of his human brother, they recruit friends to help solve the mystery of his minotaur past and fulfill his destiny.
My name is Lilith. I am the first woman who was created at the same time as Adam. My encounter with Eve will shatter the stereotypes that have been imposed on us.

films.t: Next on Netflix Animation: from "Ghostbusters: Night Shift" to Brad Bird's "Ray Gunn"
films.syn: Executive Producers Jason Reitman and Gil Kenan will join Showrunners and Executive Producers Ben Hibon and Elliott Kalan to unveil a world-exclusive behind-the-scenes look at their Ghostbusters creation before its release next year, in collaboration with Sony Pictures Animation. Next-up, stop-motion legend Peter Lord will moderate a discussion with visionary artist Brad Bird about Ray Gunn , his three-decades-long project produced by Skydance Animation. This session will also be the chance to reveal some footage from the series THE ONE PIECE and the film Charlie vs. the Chocolate Factory .

In an imaginary landscape of predators and victims, a boy and his mother exist and are sustained only by each other's love, until tragedy strikes. The film shows the tenuous balance between pain and art – how loss nurtures our songs to lead us to acceptance and forgiveness.

Vagabond ninja Jubei rescues Kagero, a poison-taster, from the demonic "Eight Devils of Kimon". Forced by a government spy into a deadly mission, the two must hunt the remaining devils. Jubei soon faces his past rival, Gemma, in a bloody battle to stop a dark conspiracy.

A wild pig 'Yao' – an evil animal spirit transformed via cultivation – from Lang Lang Mountain is banished after enraging the King. Alongside a toad friend, the outcast embarks on a quest mirroring the fabled Journey to the West , proving even a 'nobody' has a story among the gods and demons.

Get creative with Riley, a bright-eyed bunny with a big imagination who loves crafting make-believe worlds out of simple cardboard — and meeting new friends along the way. Based on the award-winning book series by Antoinette Portis.
An exploration of maternal sacrifice and female reincarnation through experimental mixed media, creating a tender yet grotesque visual to reframe motherhood.

In a bizarre clay world, an angler monster bursts into chaotic motion, rampaging through the forest of her own imagination. The monster stumbles from one surreal moment to the next. The result is a wild, grotesquely poetic ride through the subconscious, where humor and the surreal merge.
An animated music video created for Odezenne's song "Aïe aïe aïe".

A perfect day at the beach is suddenly disrupted by a rowdy crowd of oldies shuffling down the dunes. Disregarding the norms and living as they please. Sunbaking, kissing and getting on the piss. It's the Oldies of the Coast.

films.t: On the matt outside my door
films.ot: Vor meiner Tür auf einer Matte
films.syn: An oversized, cheeky rat has moved in with our protagonist. He whistles along with the radio, sits in the fridge, splashes in the tub, and is simply everywhere – loud, pesky, full of life. When the rat suddenly disappears, he realizes: it's never been this quiet – or this empty.

While dealing with a strange being that lives inside her, a woman seeks to reconcile with her sister over an incident from their adolescence. By exploring the experiences they share through their bodies, she manages to confront the nature of what inhabits her.
A young Chinese woman grapples with the guilt of using the identity of a deceased girl to immigrate to the United States via Angel Island in 1926.
A life, seen through paper.

Paris in the early 20 th century. Fujiko dreams of becoming a painter despite expectations of marriage, while Chizuru, born into a samurai family, longs to study ballet. Reunited in Paris after meeting as children, they support each other and move toward their dreams.
A journey through the interior of a mysterious home.

The PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted island with dinosaurs. They meet a pup who has become a dino-related expert. When Humdinger begins mining the islands' natural resources, he causes a dormant volcano to erupt. They must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.

Japan, 1944. 10,000 Japanese soldiers land on Peleliu. Tamaru is drafted into the army against his will, a fate shared by Yoshiki with whom he forms a friendship. Together they endure the horrors of war. Cut off in the middle of the Pacific as the global conflict draws to a close, the soldiers are left to fend for themselves.

After a trip to Antarctica, the relationship between a man and a woman takes an unexpected turn. A story about shifting perspectives in a relationship, letting go, and the responsibility that this entails.
One day, a tiny little mouse wants to take its mind off its little worries so, it decides to climb a very high mountain.
A day in the life of Pigeon Businessman.

A look ahead at Pixar's 2027 Releasing in theaters March 5, 2027, Gatto introduces a black cat named Nero who, after years of maneuvering the canal-ridden, superstitious city of Venice, Italy, begins to question whether he's lived the right lives. Indebted to a local feline mob boss, Nero finds himself in a quandary and is forced to forge a truly unexpected friendship that may finally lead him to his purpose – unless Venice gets the better of him first.
Within microscopic life, I see loneliness overlapping with a longing for something. There, a gentle waver seems to carry a hope to belong somewhere, or perhaps a wish to remain pure.
In a bustling city, various characters craving affection are searching for a relationship and find themselves caught up in situations that are comical, absurd, funny and touching.

aw: Jean-Luc Xiberras Award for a First Film

films.syn: Whenever the fearless Captain Pol dives into an adventure with her friends, everything seems to go wrong – but thanks to her unstoppable enthusiasm, they end up discovering unexpected treasures, extraordinary places, and, most importantly, each other.
A mutant praying mantis seduces and preys on men out of desperation to save her child. As the story unfolds, a failed mission leads to revelations of her past and dark secrets.

The remarkable stories of four forgotten Black women who left their mark on French history. A vertical mini-series in four 3-minute episodes, narrated by Aïssa Maïga and created using archives researched by Le Monde's editorial team.

For the 20 th Pune Design Festival, themed "India Lens", the film imagines a lens forged through a surreal machine ritual. Indian motifs are crushed, transformed inside a bioscope-like device, and flow into a lens mould – celebrating "jugaad", India's community-driven design spirit.
Great mother embodies the collective voice of the 14 families of the victims of the Alto Hospicio psychopath. Through her testimony, she reconstructs the story of their daughters.
When hate sends a text, courage replies.
When immersed in the contours swelling and waning in the forest of needles, the mundane world drifts away and we only live to breathe.

As the world folds and unfolds, collapses and re-forms, contracts and expands, lightens and darkens, breathes and expires, the film offers a shimmering mirage of what makes life worth living – the ecstasy of longing and desire, our connection to each other.

A grumpy rooster, an electric guitar and modelling clay. No, this isn't the beginning of a weird dream, but rather the new Ricoré campaign created by the Marcel agency and directed by Victor Haegelin. An exquisitely crafted stop-motion work to mark the transformation of a cult brand.

From the anarchic British comic 2000 AD , it tells the story of 19, a Genetic Infantry soldier, who is accidentally dropped behind enemy lines in the midst of a secret military operation. With the biochips of his dead brothers in tow, 19 must let his superiors know the mission ain't what they were told.

In feudal Japan, there was a land called Ashina. Under threat of invasion, its samurai turned to Kuro, the Divine Heir, and tried to use his special power for their own ends. He is rescued by Wolf, his sole retainer, but learns that his power inflicts a disease of death on others...

ap.sel: Officially selected (2026 Feature Films: Midnight Specials)

films.syn: In a dystopian paradise, angels rise against oppression. In a brutally harsh city, a lone hero joins a growing revolution. The film unfolds like a dream of resistance, where the gates of paradise are breached and hope blossoms in a new world.
There's trouble in the monkey house !

An X-rated actress stars in the Devil's cannibalistic snuff movies in exchange for beautiful skin. As she lures a fugitive bride to the studio to devour her on camera, she develops feelings that will completely disrupt the Devil's plan.
Three slaps trace the divergent values of a daughter and her father and the contradictions of the society reflected between them.
Smokedog goes about his day.

films.t: Snoop Dogg feat. Jelly Roll "Last Dance with Mary Jane"
films.syn: An experimental Snoop Dogg video by Dave Meyers and Temple Caché. Mixing live-action, 2D/3D animation, collage, motion design and restrained AI, it turns a green-screen shoot into a hallucinatory, socially aware journey shaped by human craft.

films.ot: そしてナイフを手にした
films.syn: The boy takes the knife his father had given him. Did what followed make him a "man"?

In the small village of Veredas, stands "Casa Rosa", a famous brothel run by Ismael's mother. Because of this, he is known as the "Son of a Bitch". Trying to cast aside that reality, Ismael leaves his mother in pursuit of the two things he has never met: his dad and the ocean.

During a storm, the animals in a small mountain village start behaving strangely. Emilie, who has just arrived in the valley, and her neighbour Manon decide to investigate. They discover that there's a link between their weird behaviour and the storm's songs – music that only Emilie can hear.

aw: Jury Award for a TV Special

films.syn: We follow Evolution Managers shaping life across the universe. When Dew Blue and Sunny-Yellow enter a cosmic contest, it turns into a wild battle that tests their strategy and friendship.

ap.sel: Officially selected (2026 Feature Films: Midnight Specials)

films.syn: A man lost in limbo navigates a surreal inner journey, guided by a cat embodying his conscience, confronting fears, desires and memories, discovering that life's meaning lies in the path, not the destination.

films.ot: 二十世紀電氣目録-ユーレカ・エヴリカ-
films.syn: In an alternate steampunk Kyoto, Kihachi, influenced by his brother, has always believed that electricity will power the future, creating books full of inventions. When his brother dies in the war, so does Kihachi’s dream… until he meets Inako, someone who has been making the inventions a reality.
SpongeBob and his pet snail Gary are playing with Gary's favorite ball, which gets kicked off a cliff into a dangerous, monster-filled trench.
Promo film for MONSTRA – Lisbon Animation Festival 2025. Inspired by the festival's official poster illustrated by Regina Pessoa.

films.t: Spotlight on "Fleur", Rémi Chayé's upcoming film
films.ot: Coup de projecteur sur "Fleur", le prochain film de Rémi Chayé
films.syn: Through its set design, animation and music composition, Rémi Chayé will present Fleur , his upcoming feature film starring Eddine Noël, Juliette Laurent and Florencia Di Concilio. As always, Rémi Chayé delivers a compelling historical narrative, following his exploration of remote landscapes in the Far North and the Far West, his new story centres on Paris during the Belle Époque, as seen from the suburbs. It's a chance to discover La Zone, a sprawling slum that had sprung up around the capital. Some of the creative team will be joining Rémi at this event, where you can expect to see plenty of exclusive content, music and unseen footage.

films.t: Star Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord "Chapter 9: Strange Allies"
films.syn: Maul provides an opportunity to escape the Empire, convincing Devon and our heroes to temporarily join forces with him.

One shape liquefies into a puddle, another reproduces in a vibrant entanglement, while a third convulses under the attack of a parasitic entity. This film traces an organic cycle of interaction within an unfamiliar ecosystem, revealing its radiant elegance as well as its unrelenting violence.

Happy-seijin Takopi, lands on Earth with one mission: to spread happiness! When he meets Shizuka, a lonely fourth grader, he vows to bring back her smile using his magical Happy Gadgets, but soon learns that true happiness may require more than his tech.

aw: Jury Award for a TV Series

films.syn: To tame phenomena, you're required to relinquish your control of chaos. A film on discussion and conversation, with animation, shifting between the paradigms of animation and ideas.

Told her music lacks "soul", Tana returns from Shanghai to Inner Mongolian Grasslands when her father falls ill. Guided by a fiddle fairy, she begins a journey through memory, music and the home she once longed to leave.

When Alzheimer's disease begins to strip away her mother's vibrant personality, a young woman is forced to return to her family in order to care for her. This is about a young woman coming of age, coming out and coming to terms with losing her mom, all while searching for herself.

Created using real hair. The word "tar" in Persian refers to both a strand of hair and a traditional Iranian string instrument, which adds depth to its symbolism. A centipede is disrupting a girl's world, leading to chaos and the emergence of music.

For the first time in 27 years, the annual fundraising campaign for Fundación Teletón springs to life through animation. It communicates not only the Teleton event's new date, but also the profound transformation it inspires in every Mexican kid and family it touches.
A man walks through the dark streets of a small town; the journey seems monotonous, but everything changes when he encounters a street child.

Gatlin, an outsider from the Moon, falls to Earth and meets Harper, a fierce huntress. As their bond deepens amid the celebrations of her vibrant village, the Moon’s pull grows stronger, threatening to drag him back to a lonely, distant existence.

In October 2022, after protests over Mahsa Jina Amini's death, Evin Prison became dangerously overcrowded. This follows a young woman's experience, Neda, during the fire that broke out inside, revealing personal trauma amid state repression and resilience within Iran's most notorious prison.
A bar joke goes awry, unraveling into a surreal tale that explores the acceptance of self, others, and queer identity.

An old lady gets seduced by a cunning little fox to follow him into a magical place where ANYTHING can be achieved with a clap of your hands. But in doing so, she loses what makes her unique, transforming into one of the many cranes trapped inside this paradise.
An experience that places users inside the body of Zoraan, a British-born Sikh woman navigating menopause amidst climate collapse and the ruins of colonial medicine.

A man lives all alone in a beautiful, vast land. He has everything he needs and is happy. One day, a lost traveller shows up at his door. He soon discovers that the world is much bigger than his own and that each person’s perception of things is very different.

A hunter and a female boa snake disguised as a woman meet in the dense Amazon rainforest. Their enduring romance leads to the birth of the first Kukama person, a nation known for their fishing prowess and spiritual connection to their land and water. The film is in Kukama-Kukamiria, an endangered Peruvian language.

Follow Adam and Seb, two best mates, in their daily adventures. Whether they're on the couch, at work, or out partying, with this irresistible duo, every little moment spent together turns into a great love story.

aw: Audience Award for a TV Production

films.syn: Freshman Gao Ying is trapped in the haunted South Pavilion Hotel, where he meets Yin Ting, a mysterious 300-year-old prince. To stop the deadly "Tai Sui" curse, Gao Ying must face his inner fears and fight to protect those he loves in a battle where history and supernatural reality collide.

Eight-year-old Émile is enjoying the last of the warm summer evenings with his sister Françoise. While they are eagerly scanning the night sky for shooting stars, they are suddenly interrupted by a despicably cruel act.

films.t: The Day I Licked a Pebble
films.ot: Le jour où j'ai léché un caillou
films.syn: One ordinary summer afternoon in the countryside, three siblings who are bored at their grandmother's house decide to go to the bakery to get something to eat.

The Dollhouse is an unfolding paper world where 9-year-old Juniper untangles feelings of guilt around how her family treated Magnolia, a woman who came from far away to work as a cleaner in their house.

films.t: The Doomies "Night of the Fishing Dead"
films.syn: Best friends Bobby and Romy accidentally unleash evil into their sleepy hometown in Brittany. They're helped in their fight against the creatures of doom by a mysterious teenaged warrior named Kim. In this episode, they take Kim to an arcade in the hopes of teaching her how to be a "real" teenager.
Jean, an old, nostalgic tailor, tasks his wife with altering outdated dresses. A macabre event inspires the designer to create an exquisite yet gruesome new dress.

Just as the school show is about to begin, Andréa is paralysed by stage fright and refuses to up on stage. She hides behind a makeshift cape that suddenly transports her to a magical palace hidden in the clouds. Here, she must find the courage to return and face the audience.

films.t: The Keeper of the Camphor Tree
films.syn: Alone and jobless in Tokyo after his mother's death, Reito lands in prison. With no hope left, a powerful family offers him a deal: freedom in exchange for becoming the "Keeper of the Camphor Tree," a mysterious role that will change his life forever.

Leo, a young humpback whale, dreams of finding his voice to continue his father's legacy, whose magical song once protected the ocean depths. When the terrifying Leviathan awakens, only Leo has the power to stop him. Together with his friends Willy and Darya, they set out in search of the song that could save the oceans.

films.t: The Legend of the Golden Buffalo
films.ot: Trạng Quỳnh nhí: Truyền thuyết Kim Ngưu
films.syn: Quỳnh, a gifted but arrogant boy, goes into hiding after his parents are falsely accused of stealing an imperial treasure. With village kids and a clumsy young buffalo, he uncovers a plot to unleash the Nine-Tailed Fox. To save his family and the land, Quỳnh must find the legendary Golden Buffalo.
One summer's night, cars drift about in the village square. The next day, in the same spot, a mysterious crop circle triggers a game of pelota, causing the town to grind to a halt.

films.t: The Magic Palm Theatre – Feinaki Beijing Animation Week 2025
films.ot: 指缝的魔法剧场 – 费那奇动画周宣传片
films.syn: A conjurer of optical illusions, an enchanting mermaid, a meditation bowl revealing the darker self and a clown manipulating smiling faces – distinct figures that converge in a single theatre in the palm of a hand.

Filmmaker Aami returns to her ancestral home in Kerala after her grandmother’s death. As she mourns, a childhood story narrated by her grandmother resurfaces, the tale of Shosha, a girl whose dream is stolen before it can become reality.
A young delivery rider navigates a tough day in the city, enduring many struggles but gets through it all thanks to his mother's support.

The title sequence of this series goes beyond a simple opening. Through handmade miniatures and stop-motion, it subtly hides visual clues that reflect the story of a retired detective with Alzheimer's searching for his parents' killer, gradually revealing parts of the mystery.

Giuseppe bounces from obsession to obsession, from singing to insect cataloguing, never staying in one place for long. Then he meets Pechka, a quiet balloon seller with a lingering sadness and it is the first time he wants to stay instead of chasing the next thing.

The Orbit of Minor Satellites , is a a hybrid film mixing hand drawn animation with live action. This is a psychiatrist and patient story, that travels to the hallucinatory space world that the patient has conjured. It is also about giving life and accepting death in dark times. It is also about a giant buffalo voiced by Boris Karloff.

Thanks to a magic wish, Dorian Gray remains forever young and handsome. Only his painted portrait will age. Shielded by an apparent innocence, he commits his crimes with impunity, which will ultimately lead to his downfall.

In 1819, an exhausted Francisco de Goya retires to "La Quinta del Sordo" to spend his final days away from public life and focused on his work. Unfortunately, in the deep solitude of that modest country house, the painter falls seriously ill and is visited by the ghosts of his past.

Inspired by Princess Knight by Osamu Tezuka, which is thought to be the first manga to feature a female action hero and sparked revolutionary changes within the manga/anime industry, the A-class animators are gathered to give it a new life with a modern twist.

Herve Rossini is a renowned artist who expresses himself through his surrealist garden. Tonight is the opening of his last exhibition. As he unveils his final artwork to the public, his daughter Rosalie announces that she is leaving the garden forever.

A boy turns to a magical spirit to save his sick little brother. Living in a run-down cabin on a hill above the water, he loses a dove to the cliffs below. On the beach, the spirit offers one wish — in exchange for more doves.

Irma, a woman originally from an indigenous region in Mexico, migrates to the city. As she navigates the streets of this new environment, she engages in a dialogue with herself. With each word, memories of a past life in which Irma was a jaguar roaming the vast Chinantec region start to emerge.

A scene inspired by the Seto Inland Sea is depicted in the style of a sumi-e painting, set to a violin version of the koto piece Haru No Umi ( The Spring Sea ) by Japanese koto player and composer Miyagi Michio in 1929.

films.t: The Stars Watch from Long Ago
films.syn: A tiny farmhouse spins through the cosmos, carrying silent-film icon Lillian Gish into the vast unknown. Meticulously crafted from thousands of handmade collages, this dreamlike, uncanny epic evokes wonder, loss and longing against the shadow of wildfire.

This is a true story about the complex relationship between the Israeli secret service and a famous couple of Nazi hunters. Told through the eyes of a secret agent, it speaks of the passion that drives stubborn people and the confusion of those who try to forget the past.

After surviving a violent storm at sea, a frustrated fisherman confronts a divine voice to demand answers for his life of hardship, only to discover that his suffering was a divine preparation for his true purpose.

As a Spanish reporter uncovers the mystery behind an aging violin legend and her treasured instrument, a forgotten story of love, war and music emerges. In 1930s Singapore, childhood friends Fei and Kai are bound by music until war and the Japanese occupation tear them apart.

A house is never the same after a river runs through it. This is a powerful VR documentary and immersive installation where lost objects and spaces are recreated in collaboration with people affected by the 2022 floods in eastern Australia.
Two Persian cats and a cartoonist try to make movies in the middle of a war; unfortunately, nobody understands them.
Sister remembers that Brother had jet-black eyes, hair like hers, shoulders as delicate as bird wings, and he knew the course of the river by heart. Sister remembers everything about Brother.

During their holiday, two young women get lost in a rainforest. After wandering around for days, their irritation with one another grows. While dreams about ice cream increasingly creep into their reality, they become conscious of their own vulnerability.
Battling boredom, a little boy gets trapped in the boot of a car. When he gets out, he’s no longer the same.
Catherine, a shy, romantically inclined teenager, desperately believes in the idea of a prince charming more than she believes in herself.

Created by Romance for Intermarché, and all animation produced by Wizz, the film follows an outcast wolf who discovers healthy, balanced cooking as a way to win acceptance. Blending animation and live-action shots, his quest for acceptance is brought to life by Claude François' song.
A short musical, using a novel technique of animated azulejos (painted tiles), that features a rebellious Mary joining her voice to celebrated women of history in the struggle for equality.

Back in Seville after a lengthy absence, Salva has a premonition that Carmen, a carefree young woman with a captivating voice, is in danger. Salva and his friend Belén, together with their gang of street urchins, resolve to save her. The fate of this free spirit lies in their hands.

This is a multisensory XR experience following a woman whose body becomes hollow after being reconstructed as data. Through VR cinema and a pneumatic wearable interface, audiences feel the expanding virtual volume on their bodies.

In this ambitious documentary, which has received the support of many studios and schools around the world, dozens of artists with very diverse voices share their creative philosophy and describe their very personal relationship with the form of expression they have adopted: animation.

Discover an all-new world of magic and go behind the scenes of Disney's Hexed , an original coming-of-age saga releasing exclusively in theaters this November. In Walt Disney Animation Studios' all-new magical coming-of-age saga, Hexed , an impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie (voice of Hailee Steinfeld) discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice (voice of Rashida Jones), they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever. Directed by Fawn Veerasunthorn and Jason Hand, co-directed by Josie Trinidad and produced by Roy Conli, Disney's Hexed opens exclusively in theaters November 25, 2026.

films.t: Warner Bros. Pictures Animation – A New Chapter
films.syn: Join Bill Damaschke, President and Chief Creative Officer of Warner Bros. Pictures Animation, for an exclusive look at the studio's theatrical slate and creative vision for the future. Featuring a dynamic lineup of filmmakers – Alessandro Carloni, Erica Rivinoja, Todd Wilderman, Hamish Grieve, Megan Nicole Dong, Olivier Staphylas, and more – this event offers a behind-the-scenes look at the people, stories, and artistry shaping the studio’s upcoming films. Be among the first to experience exclusive footage from The Cat in the Hat and a brand-new theatrical Looney Tunes short, Daffy Season , along with a sneak peek at the upcoming release Bad Fairies as well as other surprises.
Mia has spent her whole life free-diving, fishing and swimming through the seaweed and rocks. Over time, her body and the landscapes around her have both changed. Tonight, Mia reminisces.
Two best friends from elementary school drift apart, only to reunite decades later as adults, confronting 30 years of forgotten memories and unforgettable feelings.
Join this peculiar hero as he sings his way through a mundane office building, achieving profound results along the way.

The film follows a rising YouTuber Princess Maria's quest for fame and love spiralling into a surreal nightmare after a scandalous proposal stunt leads her to a reclusive doll maker, a haunting mansion, and the buried secrets of her own identity.
A bird restaurant nestled on a sandbank in the Wadden Sea thrives in harmony with the tide. All visitors eat and are eaten, until a single footstep throws everything off balance.

Dan has a gaping hole in his neck that won't heal. Why? He can't remember or talk about it. Back in his sinister childhood realm, he must find the part of himself he left behind that now prevents him, as an adult, from being whole.

On the eve of war in Sokhumi in 1992, 13-year-old boy experiences first love. When violence forces the girl to flee, his childhood ends. Decades later, he returns to the ruined city, chasing a summer that can never return.

Wildwood is a mythic adventure about the cost of love, the pull of power and the courage required to enter a world that may change you forever. LAIKA will be gracing this year's Festival with a sneak peek of its upcoming theatrical release, Wildwood , a highly anticipated epic, fantasy presented by the film's Director, Travis Knight.

films.ot: Winnipeg, el barco de la esperanza
films.syn: Victor, a widowed father, and his young daughter Julia leave Spain when Barcelona falls to Franco's forces in 1939. In France, camps and hardship await them. Hope appears when they board the Winnipeg, a freighter chartered by Neruda to take them to Valparaíso, Chile, where a new life may begin.
Helpless in the face of a repressive state, a young couple leaves their home – an escape that turns into a surreal nightmare.

Driven by hunger through a forest of strange cryptids, a determined Wolpertinger discovers that it's a trap to only look out for himself because it keeps the creatures predictable. Seen from a new perspective, he learns that connection, not isolation, offers him the best chance of survival.

A 10-second ident reimagining the Wonder Studios wordmark as a journey through art history – from cave paintings and the Renaissance to street art and the digital future. Using physical media and cutting-edge digital tools, it reflects Wonder's fusion of timeless storytelling and emerging technology.

Lila and Marco are brother and sister. In their bedroom, they invent extraordinary stories starring five little elves: Josie, Willy, Bibi, Pirouette and Chouchou. Welcome to the world of Woolly Woolly! A world made entirely of wool, where all the stories are hand-knitted.

films.t: World's Finest Animation: DC Studios & Warner Bros Animation
films.syn: DC Studios and Warner Bros. Animation unmask their super-powered slate, delivering first looks and creative insights into the next era of DC animation. The heroes and villains of DC take center stage at Annecy as super friends Warner Bros. Animation and DC Studios preview their upcoming slate. Join producers for exclusive first looks and behind-the-scenes insights into highly anticipated series, including Mister Miracle , My Adventures with Green Lantern , Starfire , Creature Commandos , Batman: Caped Crusader , and more. From bold new visions to iconic characters reimagined, get a front-row seat to the future of DC animation.

films.t: WTF?! – 16th Anibar International Animation Festival Trailer
films.syn: What's the future? A row of spectators is seeking answers while the world is in flames. WTF?!
In the windswept moors of Yorkshire, Helena is swept away by a tormented passion.
An obsessive exploration of the three geometric dimensions in the hope of reaching a fourth.

Set in the magical world of Notevana, curious 4-year-old YaYa discovers sound, rhythm, and melody alongside her musical friends. In this vibrant world, music lives in everything – turning everyday moments into joyful adventures.
A cathartic anthem for the absolute mad times we are living in!

films.t: You Are Not Part of the Cake
films.syn: A girl, Ping, faces conflict with her girlfriend Lala's homophobic and aggressive father, The Man. As tensions escalate, Ping is forced to take drastic action to save herself and kills The Man. This act becomes a ritual of transformation, a rebirth and a step into a new phase of life.

Meet Yugly, the ugliest dog in the world, and, weirdly, the cutest...who dreams of doing the impossible: competing in the prestigious "Best in Dog Show". Defying every obstacle, he wants to prove that even the most unlikely deserve a chance, secretly hoping, he'll find a forever family.

Ada is a young, introverted gay hairdresser from a small town in the Philippines, resigned to a life of celibacy. When a magical meteorite grants him the power to transform into a racy female superhero, he must face monsters and zombies – and even the risk of falling in love again.

ap.sel: Officially selected (2026 Feature Films: Midnight Specials)

directors.n: Hachul Le Do (Le Do Hai Chau)
